original: athavāktāmasyasaevāha | mahācatuṣpade valmiki mṛdāliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya paṃcagavyena snāpayet | 'samovaḥ kirikebhya' iti maṃtreṇa cābhi maṃtrya mānasoka iti ghṛtapāyaṃsaṃ dina dvayaṃ bilva mupaharet | dakṣiṇāmūrtau vacāphalasamartha phalaṃ susūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tāmra bhājanenyaset |
analyzed: mahā catuṣpade mṛdā liṃgam pratiṣṭhāpya paṃcagavyena snāpayet kirikebhyaḥ iti maṃtreṇa ca abhi maṃtrya mānasokaḥ iti ghṛta pāyaṃsam dina dvayam bilvam upaharet dakṣiṇāmūrtau vacā phala samartha phalam su sūkṣmam cūrṇam kṛtvā tāmra bhājane nyaset

original: kapisaghṛtenāloḍhya pradeśinyāni mutābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā pibeda pratihata vākyo bhavati | punaspayeva drāpe aṃdhanaspata ityādinā śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | vāsāṃsya kṣarāṇi bhavanti | atha vaśyakāmasya bodhāyanaḥ | pudraikādaśinī rudra mahā rudrāti rudreṣvasya tamaṃ japtvā | juhuyāt śveta puṣpāṇi saviśvaṃ kurute vaśaṃ
analyzed: āloḍhya pradeśinyāni maṃtritam kṛtvā pibet a pratihata vākyaḥ bhavati punaspayā iva drāpe aṃdhanaspate ityādinā śata sahasram juhuyāt vāsāṃsi akṣarāṇi bhavanti atha vaśya kāmasya bodhāyanaḥ japtvā juhuyāt śveta puṣpāṇi sa viśvam kurute vaśam

original: | atha kṛtsnaṃ jagatkaścidvaśī kartuṃ samīhate | nābhimātra jalasthaśca jape dudrāsanbahūṃ stathā | kṛtvā caivārcanaṃ śaṃbho rādāyaniyamaṃ tataḥ || ādityābimukho bhūtvā rudraṇāvartaye tsadā | tasyāvarta yatorudrān jitākṣasyaca dhīmataḥ | vṛṣaketu samāyāti varado bhaktavatsalaḥ || adhārogya kāmasya śaunakaḥ |
analyzed: atha kṛtsnam jagat kaścid vaśī kartum samīhate jala sthaḥ ca jape kṛtvā ca eva arcanam śaṃbhoḥ tatas kṛtvā ca eva arcanam śaṃbhoḥ tatas kṛtvā ca eva arcanam śaṃbhoḥ tatas bhūtvā yatas rudrān jita akṣasya ca dhīmataḥ vṛṣaketu samāyāti vara daḥ bhakta vatsalaḥ adha ārogya kāmasya śaunakaḥ

original: 'mano mahaṃtaṃ' iti maṃtreṇa tilāhutī nāmayutaṃ juruyāt | bālānāṃ parijananya cārogyaṃ bhavati | atha pratyupasthite sarvabhaye balīṃśca datvā | 'mīḍhuṣṭama' iti punaḥ ṣoḍasopacāraṃ kṛtvā rudraikādaśinī mekādaśa kṛtvo japtvā jāpayitvāvā rudravedinaṃ sarvebyo bhayebyaḥ pramucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
analyzed: manaḥ mahaṃtam iti maṃtreṇa tila āhutī nāma ayutam juruyāt bālānām ca ārogyam bhavati atha pratyupasthite sarva bhaye balīn ca da tvā mīḍhuṣṭamaḥ iti punar ṣoḍasā upacāram kṛtvā rudraikādaśinīm ekādaśa kṛtvas japtvā jāpayitvā vā rudra vedinam sarvebyaḥ bhayebyaḥ pramucyate na atra saṃśayaḥ

original: 'imāg rudrā' iti maṃtreṇa dadhi madhu pāyasāhutīnāṃ pratyekamayutaṃ juruyāt | sarva bhayānyupaśāmyānti | athaśānti kāmaḥ pūrvokat vithinā maṃtra devanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā devamārādhya rudravedinaṃ brāhmaṇa mācāryaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃbhu liṃgamabhigamya tatrāpyanenaiva vidhi nārādhanaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaissnārayitvā prathamānuvāke nājyāhomaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ saṃpūjya
analyzed: rudrāḥ iti maṃtreṇa dadhi madhu pāyasa āhutīnām pratyekam ayutam juruyāt sarva bhayāni upaśāmyānti kāmaḥ maṃtra deva nyāsa ādikam kṛtvā devam ārādhya rudra vedinam brāhmaṇam ācāryam kṛtvā svayaṃbhu liṃgam abhigamya tatra api anena eva vidhinā ārādhanam kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snārayitvā prathama anuvāke na ājyā homam kṛtvā devam saṃpūjya

original: 'namaste rudra manyava' ityekādaśānuvākānāṃ japaṃ kūryāt | dhārānūsrāvavayaṃ stathā japāṃte 'agnāviṣṇo sajoṣasa - ityekādaśānuvākānā mekamekaṃ japet |
analyzed: namaḥ te rudra manyave iti ekādaśa anuvākānām japam kūryāt japa aṃte agnāviṣṇo sajoṣasaḥ iti ekādaśa anuvākānām ekam ekam japet

original: punaḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāvapo ttato devaṃ samabhyarcya bhakṣyukhojyayutaṃ naivedyaṃ datvā caturaḥ pūrṇa kalaśān paṃcamṛttikā paṃcavallava paṃcaratna yutān akṣata gaṃdha dhūpādi bhirarca yitvā sitavastra veṣṇitān kṛtvā 'śaṃnovātaḥ pavatāṃ' iti śāṃtiṃ dhyayān japtvābhi ṣekaṃ kārayot | śāṃtipbhavati | tataḥ svasdhobhavati |
analyzed: punar paṃcāmṛtaiḥ devam samabhyarcya bhakṣya khojya yutam naivedyam da tvā caturaḥ pūrṇa kalaśān paṃcamṛttikā paṃcavallava paṃcaratna yutān akṣata gaṃdha dhūpa ādi bhiḥ arca yitvā sitavastra veṣṇitān kṛtvā śam naḥ vātaḥ pavatām iti śāṃtim japtvā abhiṣekam kārayet śāṃtiḥ bhavati tatas svasdhaḥ bhavati

original: ācāryāya sitavastrayugalaṃ dhenuṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyāt - brāmmaṇāṃśca bhojayeccāṃtirbhavati, punaḥ śaunakaḥ | 'mānomahāṃtaṃ' iti maṃtreṇāśavatdha manudhāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | prati saṃvatsaraṃ yātrā yāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | evaṃkṛte ātmīyasya bālastri vṛddhajātanya śāṃtiḥ |
analyzed: ācāryāya sita vastra yugalam dhenum kāṃcanam dadyāt brāmmaṇān ca bhojayet cāṃtiḥ bhavati punar śaunakaḥ iti maṃtreṇa āśavat dha manu dhāma yutam juhuyāt prati saṃvatsaram yātrā yām ayutam juhuyāt evaṃkṛte ātmīyasya śāṃtiḥ

original: namobhavāya , "namojyeṣṭhāya " ityetābhyāṃ kumāra grahādi grastānāṃ bhasmābhi maṃtrya rakṣāṃ kārayet | rātrau śikhāṃca badhniyāt kumārādi grahabhayaṃ nabhavati | 'mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama' iti mahābhaye corabhaye'gnibhaye prāṇātyayevā manasā japet kṣemeṇāgacchati | imāgṃ rudrāya , ityanena suvarṇa dūrvāṃkuraiḥ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt |
analyzed: namobhavāya namaḥ jyeṣṭhāya iti etābhyām kumāra graha ādi grastānām bhasma abhi maṃtrya rakṣām kārayet rātrau śikhāṃ ca badhniyāt kumāra ādi graha bhayam na bhavati mīḍhuṣṭama śivatamaḥ iti mahā bhaye cora bhaye agni bhaye prāṇātyaye vā manasā japet kṣemeṇa āgacchati imā gṛ rudrāya iti anena suvarṇa dūrvā aṃkuraiḥ śata sahasram juhuyāt

original: mahājvaropaghāte gatāyurapi dirghāyurbhavati | namaste rudramanyava , iti caturbhiḥ pratyṛcaṃ yava godhūmagavīdhukajartilānāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | ekādaśa dvādaśa rātreṇavā vāyumupaśamayati | 'adyavoca dadhivakta' iti sarvarakṣā kartavya |
analyzed: mahājvara upaghāte gata āyuḥ api dirgha āyuḥ bhavati namaḥ te rudra manyave iti caturbhiḥ pratyṛcam yava godhūma gavīdhuka jartilānām dadhi madhu ghṛta aktānām yutam juhuyāt ekādaśa dvādaśa rātreṇa vā vāyum upaśamayati adya voca dadhivakto iti sarva rakṣā kartavyā

original: āturebhyaḥ narṣapān saptābhi maṃtritān kṛtvā caturdiśaṃ prakṣipeddaśadikṣu rakṣā kṛtābhavati | padhigacchato' sacchāṃti mupagacchati | sarṣapeṇa brahmarāśrasa bhūta piśācādibhyo mokṣayatā | 'yatārudra śivātanū ' iti ṛgyāṃti mātayā pratisaraṃ sahasrābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā ekādaśa graṃthīn‌dattvā bālānāṃ gurviṇīnāṃ ca haste badhnīyāt |
analyzed: āturebhyaḥ narṣapān sapta abhi maṃtritān kṛtvā caturdiśam prakṣipet daśa dikṣu rakṣā kṛtā bhavati sarṣapeṇa bhūta piśāca ādibhyaḥ mokṣayatā iti ṛgyāṃti mātayā pratisaram sahasra abhi maṃtritam kṛtvā ekādaśa graṃthīn dattvā bālānām gurviṇīnām ca haste badhnīyāt

original: bāvāgurviṇyaśca sukhenavardhaṃte | yakṣa rākṣasā dyutsādanaṃ ca | sa'sahasrāṇi ' iti raktavāsa sāraktoṣṇīṣaraktamālyānu lepanairdevaṃ samarcayet |
analyzed: bāvā gurviṇyaḥ ca sukhena vardhante yakṣa rākṣasāḥ dyutsādanam ca sa sahasrāṇi iti rakta vāsas sa ārakta uṣṇīṣa rakta mālya anu lepanaiḥ devam samarcayet

original: smaśāne ekavṛkṣe nadīpuline catuṣpathevanevā kārpāsa taṃḍulaṃ paripeṣṭhatāṃ mahātaivāktāṃ smaśānāgnau pradīptena yavapiṣṭh naikādaśautri maṃtrite sayakṣa pākṣasādeḥ śatrorapi pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvo rasikaṭu tailena pratimāṃ kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇabhūtibhāge ekai kenaśareṭaikācaśa prāṇā yataneṣu vitodayet | sahasāgataṃ sakalalokagataṃvā śatramutsādayati |
analyzed: smaśāne eka vṛkṣe nadī puline kārpāsa taṃḍulam smaśāna agnau pradīptena maṃtrite sa yakṣa tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇabhūti bhāge vitodayet sahasā gatam sakala loka gatam vā śatram utsādayati

original: 'namorudrebhya' iti mathyāhne rukmakaṃṭakai rjuhuyātsarṣapaiścā haraharvā pratyapa ttīrāṣṭre devayonamaḥ sapiśācāśca bhraṃśaṃti khecarīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ yātudhānānāṃvā bhasmībhavati | adhemāḥ śāṃtayaḥ | 'imāgṃ rudrāya' iti maṃtreṇa gavāmupaghātegoṣṭha madhye'gnimupa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhāmayutaṃ juhuyāt | paśvādīnāṃ śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiriti |
analyzed: namaḥ rudrebhyaḥ iti mathyāhne rukma kaṃṭakaiḥ juhuyāt sarṣapaiḥ harahar vā devayaḥ namaḥ sa piśācāḥ ca bhraṃśaṃti khecarīṇām strīṇām yātudhānānām vā bhasmībhavati adha imāḥ śāṃtayaḥ imāgṃ rudrāya iti maṃtreṇa gavām upaghāte goṣṭha madhye agnim upa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhām ayutam juhuyāt paśu ādīnām śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiḥ iti

original: adha śatṛmārama kāmaḥ pūrvokta vithinā maṃtra devanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā devamārādhya rudravedinaṃ brāhmaṇa mācāryāṃ kṛtvā svayaṃbhu liṃgamabhigamya tatrāpyanenaiva vidhi nārādhanaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtai snāpayitvā prathamānuvāke nājyāhomaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ saṃpūjya 'namaste rudra masyava' ityekādaśānukānāṃ japaṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: adha pūrva ukta vithinā maṃtra deva nyāsa ādikam kṛtvā devam ārādhya rudra vedinam brāhmaṇam ācāryām kṛtvā svayaṃbhu liṃgam abhigamya tatra api anena eva vidhinā ārādhanam kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayitvā prathama anuvāke na ājyā homam kṛtvā devam saṃpūjya namaḥ te rudra masyavaḥ iti ekādaśa anukānām japam kuryāt

original: dhārānū srāvayaṃ stathā japāṃte 'agnāviṣṇo lajoṣasa' ityekādaśānukānā mekamekaṃ japet
analyzed: dhārā anū srāvayan stathā japa aṃte agnāviṣṇo lajā uṣasaḥ iti ekādaśa anukānām ekam ekam japet

original: | punaḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpaye ttato devaṃ samabhyarcya bhakṣyakhojyayutaṃ naivedyaṃ datvā caturaḥ pūrṇa kalaśān paṃcamṛtiktā paṃcapallava paṃcaratna yutān akṣata gaṃdha dhūpādi bhirarca yitvā sitavastra veṣṇitān kṛtvā 'śaṃnovātaḥ savatāṃ' iti śāṃtiṃ dhyāyan japtvābhiṣekaṃ kārayet | śāṃtirbhavati | tataḥ svasthobhavati |
analyzed: punar paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayet tatas devam samabhyarcya bhakṣya khojya yutam naivedyam da tvā caturaḥ pūrṇa kalaśān paṃcamṛtiktā paṃcapallava paṃcaratna yutān akṣata gaṃdha dhūpa ādi bhiḥ arca yitvā sitavastra veṣṇitān kṛtvā śam naḥ vātaḥ savatām iti śāṃtim dhyāyan japtvā abhiṣekam kārayet śāṃtiḥ bhavati tatas svasthaḥ bhavati

original: ācāryāya sitavastrayugalaṃ dhenuṃ kāṃcanaṃ dadyāt - brāhmaṇāṃśca bhojayeccāṃtirbhavati, punaḥ śaunakaḥ | 'mānomahāṃtaṃ' iti maṃtraṃṇāśvattha samidhāmayutaṃ jīhuyāt | evaṃkṛte ātmīyasya bāla strī vṛddajātasya śāṃtiḥ | namobhavāya | "namojyeṣṭhāya" itye tābhyāṃ kumāra grahādi grastānāṃ bhasmābhi maṃtrya rakṣāṃ kārayet |
analyzed: ācāryāya sita vastra yugalam dhenum kāṃcanam dadyāt brāhmaṇān ca bhojayet cāṃtiḥ bhavati punar śaunakaḥ iti maṃtraṃṇa aśvattha samidhām ayutam jīhuyāt evaṃkṛte ātmīyasya bāla strī vṛdda jātasya śāṃtiḥ namaḥ bhavāya namaḥ jyeṣṭhāya iti e tābhyām kumāra graha ādi grastānām bhasma abhi maṃtrya rakṣām kārayet

original: rātrau śikhāṃca badhnīyāt kumārādi grahabhayaṃ nabhavati | 'miḍhuṣṭama śivatama' iti mahābhayo corabhaye'gnibhaye prāṇātyayovā manasā japet kṣemeṇāgacchati | imāgṃ rudrāya , ityanena suvarṇa dūrvāṃkūraiḥ śata sahasraṃ juhuyāt | mahājvaropaghāte gatā yurasi dīrghāyurbhavati |
analyzed: rātrau śikhām ca badhnīyāt kumāra ādi graha bhayam na bhavati miḍhuṣṭama śivatamaḥ iti mahā bhaye cora bhaye agni bhaye manasā japet kṣemeṇa āgacchati imāgṃ rudrāya iti anena suvarṇa dūrvā aṃkūraiḥ śata sahasram juhuyāt mahājvara upaghāte dīrgha āyuḥ bhavati

original: namaste pudramanyapa, iti caturbiḥ pratyṛcaṃ yava godhūmagavīdhukajartilānāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāma yutaṃ juhuyāt | ekādaśa dvādaśa rātreṇavā vāyumupaśamayati | 'ādyavoca dadhivaktā ' iti sarvarakṣā kartavyā | āturebhyaḥ sarṣapān saptābhi maṃtritān kṛtvā caturdiśaṃ prakṣi peddaśadikṣu rakṣā kṛtābhavati | padigacchato' sacchāṃti mupagacchati |
analyzed: namaḥ te pudra manyape iti caturbiḥ pratyṛcam yava godhūma gavīdhuka jartilānām dadhi madhu ghṛta aktānām yutam juhuyāt ekādaśa dvādaśa vā vāyum upaśamayati ādi avoca dadhivaktā iti sarva rakṣā kartavyā āturebhyaḥ sarṣapān sapta abhi maṃtritān kṛtvā caturdiśam prakṣi pet daśa dikṣu rakṣā kṛtā bhavati sat śāṃtim upagacchati

original: sarṣapeṇa brahmarākṣasa bhūta piśācādibhyo mokṣayati | 'yatārudra śivātanū' iti ṛgvāṃti mātayā pratisaraṃ sahasrābhi maṃtritaṃ kṛtvā ekādaśa graṃthīn‌datvā bālānāṃ gurviṇīnāṃ cahaste ca haste badnīyāt | bālāgurviṇyaśca sukhe navardhaṃte | yakṣa rākṣasā dyutsādanaṃ ca |
analyzed: sarṣapeṇa brahmarākṣasa bhūta piśāca ādibhyaḥ mokṣayati yata a rudra śiva a tanū iti ṛgvāṃti mātayā pratisaram sahasra abhi maṃtritam kṛtvā ekādaśa graṃthīn datvā bālānām gurviṇīnām ca haste ca haste badnīyāt bālā gurviṇyaḥ ca sukhe yakṣa rākṣasāḥ dyut sādanam ca

original: ' sahasrāṇi ' iti raktavāsa sāraktoṣṇīṣa ra ktamālyānu lepanairdevaṃ samarchayet | smaśāne ekāvṛkṣe nadīpuline catuṣpathevanevā kārpāsa taṃḍulaṃ paripeṣṭitāṃ mahātailāktāṃ smaśānāgmau pradīpaina yavapiṣṭh naikādaśābhi maṃtrite sayakṣa rākṣasādeḥ ratrorapi pratikṛtiṃ kṛtvo pasikaṭu tailena pratimāṃ kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇabhūmibhāge ekai kenaśaro
analyzed: sahasrāṇi iti lepanaiḥ devam samarchayet smaśāne ekā vṛkṣe nadī puline kārpāsa taṃḍulam paripeṣṭitām mahā taila aktām smaśāna agmau tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇa bhūmi bhāge tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇa bhūmi bhāge tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇa bhūmi bhāge tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇa bhūmi bhāge tailena pratimām kṛtvā sthāpya dakṣiṇa bhūmi bhāge

original: ṇaikācaśa prāṇāyataneṣu vitodayet | sahasāgataṃ sakalalokagataṃvā śatrumutsādayati | 'namorudrebhya' iti madhyāhne devayonayaḥ sapiśacāśca bhraṃśaṃti khecarīṇāṃ strīṇāṃ yūtudhānānāṃvā bhasmībhavati | adhemāḥ śāṃtayaḥ | 'imāgṃ rūdrāya' iti maṃtreṇa gavāmupaghātegoṣṭha madhye'gnimupa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samudhāmayutaṃ juhuyāt |
analyzed: prāṇa āyataneṣu vitodayet sahasā gatam sakala loka gatam vā śatrum utsādayati namaḥ rudrebhyaḥ iti madhyāhne devayonayaḥ sa piśacāḥ ca bhraṃśaṃti khecarīṇām strīṇām yūtudhānānām vā bhasmībhavati adha imāḥ śāṃtayaḥ imāgṃ rūdrāya iti maṃtreṇa gavām upaghāte goṣṭha madhye agnim upa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samudhām ayutam juhuyāt

original: gavāṃ śāṃtirbhavati | yāvaṃtaśca tuṣṭadāstāvadbhya evamevaśāṃtividhiṃ kuryat | "namaste rudramanyava" ityanena gavāmupaghāte goṣṭhamadhye'gnimupa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhāyayutaṃ juhuyāt | paśvādīnāṃ śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiriti |
analyzed: gavām śāṃtiḥ bhavati yāvaṃtaḥ ca tuṣṭa dāḥ tāvadbhyaḥ evam eva śāṃti vidhim kuryat namaḥ te rudra manyave iti anena gavām upaghāte goṣṭha madhye agnim upa samādhāya vaikaṃkata samidhāya yutam juhuyāt paśu ādīnām śāṃti dviguṇena mahāśāṃtiḥ iti

original: nityavadanenasvāgnau sarpiṣāṣṭa sahasramaṣṭaśataṃvā āhutīrjuhuyāt | dūrvāṇāmaṣṭasahasraṃ dadhi madhughutāktānāṃ juhuyāt | svajanmakṣatre nityamevāṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | ārdrayāṃ viśeṣeṇa | pratyārdhraṃ dūrvāpāmārgaśamī tilānāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktānāṃ pratyekamayutamāhutī rjuhuyāt | rātrauyāvatpaṃcasahasraṃ japet | tāvatpradakṣiṇāḥ kuryāt |
analyzed: nitya vadanena sva agnau sarpiṣā aṣṭa sahasram aṣṭaśatam vā āhutīḥ juhuyāt dūrvāṇām aṣṭa sahasram dadhi madhu ghuta aktānām juhuyāt sva janma kṣatre nityam eva aṣṭa sahasram japet ārdrayām viśeṣeṇa pratyārdhram dūrvā apāmārga śamī tilānām dadhi madhu ghṛta aktānām pratyekam ayutam āhutīḥ juhuyāt rātrau yāvat paṃca sahasram japet tāvat pradakṣiṇāḥ kuryāt

original: rājājanmadine durvāpādhumārgādi pratyekaṃyutaṃ juhuyāt | rājā dīrghāyurbhavati | aśaktānāṃ srotasihomaḥ | tatostyaṃtāśaktānāṃ japaeva | śuddhataṃḍulai rmadhvājyāktairayutaṃ juhuyāttasyāyurvardhate | maṃtreṇā nenadevasyopari arkasumanobhirayuta mārādhayet | tasya śrīrvardhate |

original: paścimadvārāvayevācarubojī adhaśśāyī brahmacarmavā nakṣāravaṇāśī devamabhitaḥ sahasraṃjape deṃvakṛte śatāyuḥ saptajanmasubhavati | āśaktasyabhakṣāharaḥ praśasta iti ||

kurvāṇam sannidhau devyāḥ devam ānaṃda tāṃjavam

original: maṃ|| oṃ - stuhi | śrutaṃgarta sadaṃyuvānaṃ mṛgaṃnabhīmamupahatnu mugraṃ | mṛḍājaritre rudrastavāno anyaṃte asminnivapaṃtu senāḥ || ||
analyzed: maṃ om stuhi śrutaṃgarta sadaṃyuvānam mṛgaṃna bhīmam upahatnu mugram mṛḍa ajaritre rudraḥ stavānaḥ anyaṃte asmin nivapaṃtu senāḥ

original: adhāsya puraścaraṇaṃ | ekarātra mupoṣya trirātraṃ niraṃtaraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇo bhavati | vaikaṃkata samīdāṃ viṣatai lāktānāṃ śmaśānāgnau lakṣaṃ juhuyāt | śatravonaśyati |

original: śatrunāma grahaṇaṃ kṛtvā devasya sannidhau bhasma pāṇirayutaṃ japet | tasyaśakṣorma hajvarobhavati | śvetasiddhārdrayutaṃ juhuyāt | śatrormasūrikā jāyaṃte | tābhirevamriyate | śatrora, gṛhakṣetrādiṣu
analyzed: śatru nāma grahaṇam kṛtvā devasya sannidhau bhasma pāṇiḥ ayutam japet tasya śakṣoḥ maha jvaraḥ bhavati śveta siddha ārdra yutam juhuyāt śatroḥ masūrikāḥ jāyante tābhiḥ eva mriyate śatroḥ gṛha kṣetra ādiṣu

original: maṃtreṇānenāvaṭaṃkhānayutvā tatrakalpaṃ romāsthi śarkarādikaṃkhātayet | tasyaśīghraṃ nāśobhavati ||

original: adhāsya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇaṃ | kṛccracaritvā navadināni pratidina maṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | kṛta puraścaraṇobhavati | ānena putra kāmānāmeva kartavyaṃ | etadapi guptaṃ kuryāt | dāvānalarūḍhanya phalāśakhadirādeḥ samidhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānāḥ paścimadvāre śivālayetvāyutaṃ juhuyāt | śivasadṛśaṃ putraṃlabhate |
analyzed: adha asya maṃtrasya puraścaraṇam kṛccra caritvā nava dināni pratidinam aṣṭa sahasram japet kṛta puraścaraṇaḥ bhavati ā anena putra kāmānām eva kartavyam etat api guptam kuryāt samidhām dadhi madhu ghṛta akta anāḥ paścima dvāre juhuyāt śiva sadṛśam putram labhate

original: devāvaye aśvaddhachāyā yāmātma gṛha goṣṭhayorvā ārdhrāyāmamāvāsyāyāvaṃvā kṛṣṇapakṣe aṣṭamyāṃvā prāraṃbhaḥ | pūrvedyuścaru bhojanā daṃpatī bhavataḥ | prati maṃtrākṣaraṃ kalaśāṃ staṃtuveṣṭitān jalapūrṇān pratiṣṭhāvyateṣāṃ madhye kuṃbhamuccaistaraṃ nidhāya tasmin devaṃ somamāvāhayet | āyātu bhagavān kailāsāt |
analyzed: devāvaye ārdhrāyām amāvāsyāyāḥ vā kṛṣṇa pakṣe aṣṭamyām vā prāraṃbhaḥ pūrvedyus caru bhojanā daṃpatī bhavataḥ prati maṃtra akṣaram kalaśān staṃtu veṣṭitān jala pūrṇān madhye kuṃbham uccaistaram nidhāya tasmin devam somam āvāhayet āyātu bhagavān kailāsāt

original: iti āvāhya gaṃthādibhirabhyarcya tataḥ pūrvavanmadhya kalaśa mārabhya pratikalaśaṃ maṃtrādita ekameka makṣaraṃnyaset | tato nava sahasraṃ japet | tata uddeśakāgnau śyāmākalājānāṃ madhughṛtāktānāmaṣṭa sahasraṃ hutvā tanmātra mājyenaca hutvā tata ādi kalaśa mādāya tattadatrararūpiṇaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ smaran srāpayet |
analyzed: iti āvāhya gantha ādibhiḥ abhyarcya tatas pūrvavat madhya kalaśam ārabhya pratikalaśam maṃtra āditaḥ ekam ekam akṣaram nyaset tatas nava sahasram japet tatas uddeśaka agnau śyāmāka lājānām madhu ghṛta aktānām aṣṭa sahasram hutvā tad mātram ājyena ca hutvā tatas ādi kalaśam ādāya tad tad atrara rūpiṇam bhagavaṃtam smaran srāpayet

original: ekāsanametau pratiṣṭhāpya kubhajalenaca snāpayitvā brāhmaṇānāmasṭa sahasra maṣṭaśataṃvā ekaśata maṃte bhojayet | tatra kasala vastravrīhyādīnācāryasya datvātaṃ bhojayitvā dakṣiṇākele paṃcaniṣkaṃ trayaṃvādadyādevaṃ rūpāyā dakṣaṇāyāḥ kiṃcidapinyūnaṃ nabhavedevaṃdatvā daṃpatī bhuṃjīyātāmevaṃ tayo putraḥ śivatamodīrghāyurutpadyate |

original: athapūrvokta karmāśa ktava paramucyate | aśakto maṃtramimaṃ japet | paścimādvāre devālaye ahorātraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt | udayā tprabhṛtyāstamāyāt astamāyā tprabhṛtyodayā ttatravavighnoyadi midyate aśaktāna saṃticet | śaktasanna śaktamātmānaṃ matvākurvan naśyati | tasmātpuraścaraṇayukto gururapramattaḥ kūryāditi |
analyzed: param ucyate aśaktaḥ maṃtram imam japet paścimā dvāre devālaye ahorātram pradakṣiṇam kuryāt udayāt prabhṛti astamāyāt astamāyāt prabhṛti udayāt tatra vai vighnaḥ yadi midyate saṃti ced śakta san na śaktam ātmānam matvā a kurvan naśyati tasmāt puraścaraṇa yuktaḥ guruḥ apramattaḥ kūryāt iti

original: aśaktānāṃ prajākāmānā magatīnāmanugrahaṃ vakṣyāt | nityavadaśvatthasya pūrvottara mūlādārabhya aṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | aśvaddha caturdikṣu pratidina maṣṭa sahasraṃ japet | evaṃ samāpya yāvaccaktitāvadvā brahmaṇān dīkṣāyuktān bhojaye devaṃkṛte vaṃśakaraṃ putraṃ labhata iti |

original: samidhāmayutaṃ jāhuyāt | bhayaṃna bhapati | sarvān jetu kāmospāmārga samidhāṃ kapilājyapiktānāṃ śata sahasra māhutī rjuhuyāt | etenaiva varāhadayo vaśyā bhavaṃti | tiraścojetu kāmobilva samudhāṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtāktānaṃ śata sahasra māhutīrjuhuyāt | etenaiva varāhadayo vaśyā bhavaṃti |
analyzed: samidhām ayutam jāhuyāt bhayaṃna sarvān jetu kāmaḥ uspāmārga samidhām kapila ājya piktānām śata sahasram āhutīḥ juhuyāt etena eva varāhadayaḥ vaśyāḥ bhavanti tiraścaḥ jetu kāmaḥ bilva samudhām dadhi madhu ghṛta aktānam śata sahasram āhutīḥ juhuyāt etena eva varāhadayaḥ vaśyāḥ bhavanti

original: rakṣāṃtu kārayettena śiraḥ kaṃṭhāṃ sakeṣuca || mātsye || evaṃ samagraṃ niṣpādya sarvadevān visarjayet || yāṃtudeva gaṇāḥ ssarve pūjāmādāya pārdhivīṃ || iṣṭakāma samṛdyardhaṃ punarāga manāyaca || anena vidhināyastu grahapūjāṃ samācaret || sarvānkāmānnavāpnoti prītyasvarge mahīyate || yastupīḍā karotyaṃta malpavittasya vāgrataḥ ||
analyzed: rakṣām tu kārayet tena śiraḥ kaṃṭhām sakeṣu ca mātsye evam samagram niṣpādya sarva devān visarjayet gaṇāḥ ssarve pūjām ādāya pārdhivīm iṣṭa kāma samṛdi ardham anena vidhinā ayaḥ tu graha pūjām samācaret sarvān kāmān na vāpnoti prītya svarge mahīyate yaḥ tu pīḍā karoti antam alpa vittasya vā agratas

original: satuyatnena saṃpūjya śśeṣānapyarcayennaraḥ || tathā || sadaivāyuta homoyaṃ navagrahamakhaḥ smṛtaḥ || vivāhotsava yajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu | nirvighnārdhaṃ muniśreṣṭha tadhodvegādbhuteṣuca || vaśyakarmābhitārā dautadhaivoccāṭanādike || navagraha makhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet || anyadhāphaladaṃ puṃsāṃsa kāmaṃ jāyate kvacit ||
analyzed: satu yatnena saṃpūjya śūṣān api arcayet naraḥ tathā sadā eva ayuta homaḥ yam nava graha makhaḥ smṛtaḥ vivāha utsava yajñeṣu pratiṣṭhā ādiṣu karmasu nirvighna ardham muni śreṣṭha vaśya karma abhitārā nava graha makham kṛtvā tatas karma samārabhet anyadhā phala dam kāmam jāyate kvacid

original: adbhutaṃ bhūkaṃpādi || anyaścātra viśeṣo matkṛta prayoga dīpikāyāṃjñeyaḥ || yattuśiṣṭāḥ || grahamaṃtrāṇāmayuta sahasrādi saṃkhyayā japaṃ kṛtvā taddaśāṃśena tilairhomaṃ kurvaṃti || tatkutrāpi japānukte || japānukte || kiṃ mūlaka mitina midmaḥ || ityayuta homa vidhiḥ || adha prayogaḥ ||
analyzed: adbhutam bhūkaṃpa ādi anyaḥ ca atra viśeṣaḥ mad kṛta prayoga dīpikāyām jñeyaḥ yat tu śiṣṭāḥ graha maṃtrāṇām ayuta sahasra ādi saṃkhyayā japam kṛtvā tad daśa aṃśena tilaiḥ homam kurvaṃti tat kutra api japa anukte japa anukte kim mūlaka miti na midmaḥ iti ayuta homa vidhiḥ adha prayogaḥ

original: sacayadyapyasmatpitāmaha kṛtosyaivatadhāpi saṃkṣepiṇocyate || kartādeśakālau smṛtvā śrīkāmaḥ graha pīḍayā mutpāte roge vātacchāṃti kāmaḥ śatṛparājaya kāmo vāyutahomākhya navagraha yajñena yaṣye || kevaletu grahayajñaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya || gaṇeśa pūjāṃ mātṛkā pūjāṃ vṛddhi śrāddhaṃ kṛtvāscāryaṃ vṛtvā || prārdhayet ||
analyzed: saca yadi api asmad pitāmaha saṃkṣepiṇā ucyate kartā deśa kālau smṛtvā śrī kāmaḥ graha pīḍayā mutpāte roge vāta chāṃti kāmaḥ kāmaḥ vā ayuta homa ākhya nava graha yajñena yaṣye kevale tu graha yajñam kariṣye iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśa pūjām mātṛkā pūjām vṛddhi śrāddham kṛtvā āscāryam vṛtvā prārdhayet

original: tvannogatiḥ pitā mātātvaṃgatiḥ tvaṃ parāyaṇaṃ tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvaṃmesyānmanogataṃ || āpadvimokṣāyacame kuruyajñamatraṃditaḥ || koṭi homākhya matulaṃ śāṃtyardhaṃ sarvakāma damiti caturaḥ ṛtvijovṛṇuyāt || yadvāsācāryo brahmaceti dvauteṣāṃ tacchākhayā madhuparka || tadāhahemādrau viśvāmitraḥ || saṃpūjya madhuparkeṇa ṛtvijam̐ karmakārayet ||
analyzed: tvat nogatiḥ pitā mātā tvaṃgatiḥ tvam parāyaṇam tvad prasādena viprarṣe sarvam me syāt manogatam kuru yajñam atraṃditaḥ kuru yajñam atraṃditaḥ homa ākhyam atulam śāṃti ardham sarva kāma dam iti caturaḥ ṛtvijaḥ vṛṇuyāt tat vā ācāryaḥ brahmacā iti dvau teṣām tad śākhayā tat āha hemādrau viśvāmitraḥ saṃpūjya madhuparkeṇa ṛtvijam karma kārayet

original: anyadhā viphalaṃ bhavedihana saṃśaya iti || nacārcya śākhayākāryaḥ || arcyaśākhayā madhuparka iti tatraivasmṛteḥ || tato daśahasta maṣṭahastaṃvā maṃṭapaṃ kṛtvā || tanmadhye hastamātraṃ kuṃḍaṃ kuryāt || īśāne kuṃmuti hemādriḥ || tadīśānyāṃ vedirhasta vistṛtā vitastyuccāva pradvayayutā caturaśrā kārya ādyava prodvyaṃguloccaḥ ||
analyzed: anyadhā viphalam saṃśayaḥ iti na ca arcya śākhayā a kāryaḥ arcya śākhayā madhuparkaḥ iti tatra eva smṛteḥ tatas daśa hastam aṣṭa hastam vā maṃṭapam kṛtvā tad madhye hasta mātram kuṃḍam kuryāt īśāne hemādriḥ tad īśānyām vediḥ hasta vistṛtā pradvaya yutā caturaśrā kāryaḥ
dvitīyaḥ tri aṃgula uccaḥ

original: dvāvapidvyaṃgula vistārauvā || tataḥ śūklāṃbara dharaḥ śukla mālyānulepanaḥ || sācāryartvigyajamāno maṃgalaghoṣeṣa jalapūrṇa kalaśahastaḥ || oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ janitvamiti maṃtrai maṃṭapaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtya paścimadvāreṇa praviśya || yadatra saṃsthitaṃ bhūtaṃsthāna māśritya sarvādā || sthānaṃ tyaktātu tatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatragaccatu ||
analyzed: dvau api dvi aṃgula vistārau vā tatas śūkla aṃbara dharaḥ śukla mālya anulepanaḥ sa ācārya ṛtvij yajamānaḥ maṃgala ghoṣeṇa jala pūrṇa kalaśa hastaḥ om bhadram karṇebhiḥ janitvam iti maṃtraiḥ maṃṭapam pradakṣiṇam kṛtya paścima dvāreṇa praviśya yat atra saṃsthitam bhūtam sthānam āśritya sarvādā sthānam tyaktātu tat sarvam yatrastham tatra gaccatu

original: apakrāmaṃtu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvatodiśaṃ || sarveṣā mavirodhena brahmakarma samāpabhe || iti gaurava sarṣapān nvikīrya | śucīvo halyetyṛcai, āpohiṣṭhenyṛcāca, bhūmiṃ prokṣya, svastayanaṃtākṣan, miti maṃtradvayaṃ japet - tatomaṃṭapapakṣenai ṛrte vāstuvedikāṃ kṛtvā vedīśānādīkoṇa catuṣke || viśaṃtu bhūtale nāgāloka pālāśca sarvataḥ ||
analyzed: apakrāmaṃtu bhūtāni piśācāḥ sarvatodiśam sarveṣām avirodhena brahmakarma iti gaurava sarṣapān nu ikīrya śucīvas halya iti ṛcai bhūmim prokṣya miti maṃtra dvayam japet vāstu vedikām kṛtvā vedi īśāna ādī koṇa catuṣke viśaṃtu bhū tale nāga āloka pālāḥ ca sarvatas

original: maṃṭapesmi nmitiṣṭhaṃtu āyurbala karāssadeti || maṃtreṇa caturaḥ śaṃkin ropayitvā || tataḥ āgneyādi śaṃku pārśveṣu māṣabhakta balīn‌dadyātu || agnibhyopyatha sarvebhyo yecānyetatra saṃsthitāḥ || tebhyobaliṃ prayaccāmi puṇyamodana muttamaṃ || iti - evaṃ maṃtra trayeṇa nairṛti vāyvīśāna śaṃku pārśveṣu māṣabhakta balīn‌datvā || teca maṃtrāḥ ||
analyzed: maṃṭapesmi āyuḥ bala karāḥ sadā iti maṃtreṇa caturaḥ ropayitvā tatas āgneya ādi śaṃku pārśveṣu māṣabhakta balīn dadyātu agnibhyaḥ api atha sarvebhyaḥ ye ca anye tatra saṃsthitāḥ tebhyaḥ balim prayaccāmi puṇyam odana muttamam iti evam maṃtra trayeṇa nairṛti vāyu īśāna śaṃku pārśveṣu māṣabhakta balīn datvā te ca maṃtrāḥ nairṛti vāyu īśāna śaṃku pārśveṣu māṣabhakta balīn datvā te ca maṃtrāḥ nairṛti vāyu īśāna

original: nairṛtyādhipatiścaiva nai ṛtyāṃ yecarākṣasāḥ | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarvegṛhṇaṃtvimaṃ baliṃ || namo vāyustharakṣebhyoyocānye tatsamāśritāḥ baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarve gṛhṇaṃtvimaṃ baliṃ || rudrebhyaścaiva sarvebhyoyocānye tatsamāśritāḥ | baliṃtebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇaṃtu satatotsukāḥ || tatovedyuparivastre savarṇādiśalākayā ||
analyzed: nairṛtya adhipatiḥ ca eva nai ṛtyām ye ca rākṣasāḥ balim tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarve gṛhṇaṃtu imam balim namaḥ vāyu stha rakṣebhyaḥ yaḥ ca anye tad samāśritāḥ balim tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarve gṛhṇaṃtu imam balim rudrebhyaḥ ca eva sarvebhyaḥ yaḥ ca anye tad samāśritāḥ balim tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇaṃtu satata utsukāḥ tatas vedi upari vastre savarṇa ādi śalākayā

original: ṣaṃ śāṃtāyai namaḥ - oṃ yaśovatyai namaḥ - oṃ kāṃtāyai namaḥ - oṃ viśālāyainamaḥ - oṃ prāṇavāhinyai namaḥ - oṃ satyai namaḥ - oṃ sumanāyai namaḥ - oṃ naṃdāyai namaḥ - oṃ bhadrayai namaḥ || iti paścādārabhya prāgaṃtā udaksaṃsthānavarekhāḥ kṛtvā |
analyzed: ṣaṃ śāṃtāyai namaḥ om yaśovatyai namaḥ om kāṃtāyai namaḥ om viśālāyai namaḥ om prāṇavāhinyai namaḥ om satyai namaḥ om sumanāyai namaḥ om naṃdāyai namaḥ om bhadrayai namaḥ iti paścāt ārabhya prāc aṃtāḥ udak saṃsthāna varekhāḥ kṛtvā

original: punaḥ oṃ hiraṇyāyau namaḥ - oṃ suprabhāyai namaḥ - oṃ lakṣmyai namaḥ - oṃ vibhūtyai namaḥ - oṃ vimalāyai namaḥ - oṃ vidyāyai namaḥ - oṃ jayāyai namaḥ - oṃ kālāyai namaḥ - oṃ viśokāyai namaḥ || iti dakṣiṇā raṃbhā udagaṃtāḥ prāksaṃ sthānavarekhāḥ kṛtvā madhyakoṣṭa catuṣṭayamekī kṛtya koṇeṣu rekhāṃ datvā tenārdhapadāni saṃpadyaṃ te ||
analyzed: punar om namaḥ om suprabhāyai namaḥ om lakṣmyai namaḥ om vibhūtyai namaḥ om vimalāyai namaḥ om vidyāyai namaḥ om jayāyai namaḥ om kālāyai namaḥ om viśokāyai namaḥ iti dakṣiṇā raṃbhā udak aṃtāḥ prāk saṃ sthānava rekhāḥ kṛtvā koṇeṣu rekhām da tvā tena ardha padāni saṃpadyam te

original: tatastatra brahmadīnā vāhayet || vāstoścaturaśraṃ śarīraṃdevā ākramya sthitā iti || tattadevapadeca tattaddevānā māvāhanaṃ - tatra madhyapada cutaṣke hṛdaye brahmaṇenama iti - brahmaṇaṃ āvāhayāmityāvāhya, pūrvapadadvaye dakṣiṇa stane āryamṇe namaḥ ityaryamṇa māvāhayāmi | dakṣiṇa padadvaye ḍaṭhara dakṣiṇe vivasvate namaḥ vivasvaṃta māvāhayāmi |
analyzed: tatas tatra vāhayet vāstoḥ caturaśram śarīram devāḥ ākramya sthitāḥ iti tad tad deva pade ca tad tad devānām āvāhanam tatra hṛdaye brahmaṇe namaḥ iti brahmaṇaṃ āvāhayām iti āvāhya pūrva pada dvaye dakṣiṇa stane āryamṇe namaḥ iti aryamṇaṃ māvāhayāmi dakṣiṇa pada dvaye ḍaṭhara dakṣiṇe vivasvate namaḥ vivasvantam māvāhayāmi

original: paścima padadvaye jaṭhara dakṣiṇe vivasvate namaḥ vivasvaṃta māvāhayāmi | paścima padadvaye jaṭharavāme mitrāya namaḥ mitraṃ māvāhayāmi | udak‌padadvavāmastane pṛdhivīdharāyanamaḥ pṛthīvī dhara māvāhayāmi | tatrabrahmasamīpasthāne agneya padārthayordakṣiṇa haste sāvitra savitārau || tatra pūrvārdhe sāvitryāyanamaḥ sāvitrya māhavāyāmi |
analyzed: paścima pada dvaye jaṭhara dakṣiṇe vivasvate namaḥ vivasvaṃta mā āvāhayāmi paścima pada dvaye jaṭhara vāme mitrāya namaḥ mitram mā āvāhayāmi udak pada dva vāma stane pṛdhivīdharāya namaḥ pṛthīvī dhara mā āvāhayāmi tatra brahma samīpa sthāne agneya padārthayoḥ dakṣiṇa haste sāvitra savitārau tatra pūrva ardhe sāvitryāya namaḥ sāvitrya māhava āyāmi

original: paścimārthe savitre namaḥ savitāra māvāhayāmi || naiṛtya padārthayo vṛṣaṇameḍhrayorvi budhādhipajayau | tatrapūrvārdhe vibudhādipāya namaḥ
analyzed: paścima arthe savitre namaḥ savitāra mā āvāhayāmi naiṛtya vṛṣaṇa meḍhrayoḥ vi budha adhipa jayau tatra pūrva ardhe vibudha ādipāya namaḥ

original: vibudhādhipa māvāhayāmi | tatra paścimārdhe jayāya namaḥ jaya māvāhayāmi || vāyuvya parārdhayorvā māhaste rājayakṣmaṇa rudraya namaḥ | tatra pūrvārdhe rājayakṣmaṇe namaḥ rājayakṣmaṇa māvāhayāmi || paścimapadārthe rudraya namaḥ rudramāvāhayāmi || īśāna
analyzed: vibudha adhipa mā āvāhayāmi tatra paścima ardhe jayāya namaḥ jaya mā āvāhayāmi namaḥ tatra pūrva ardhe rājayakṣmaṇe namaḥ rājayakṣmaṇa mā āvāhayāmi paścima padārthe namaḥ rudram āvāhayāmi īśāna

original: padārdhayo rūraumukhe pāpavatsau | tatra pūrvārdhe ādbhyo namaḥ ityapaḥ māvāhayāmi | paścimārthe āpavatsāya namaḥ āpavatsaṃ māvāhayāmi || īśānapada dakṣiṇārthe vāsto śirasi
analyzed: pada ardhayoḥ pāpa vatsau tatra pūrva ardhe ā adbhyaḥ namaḥ iti apaḥ mā āvāhayāmi paścima arthe āpa vatsāya namaḥ āpa vatsam mā āvāhayāmi īśāna pada dakṣiṇa arthe śirasi

original: śikhine namaḥ śibhina māvāhayāmi | taddakṣiṇa sārdhapade dakṣiṇanetre parḍanyāya namaḥ parjanya māvāhayāmi | taddakṣima padadvaye dakṣiṇaśotre jayaṃ tāya namaḥ - jayaṃta māvāhayāmi | taddakṣiṇa padadvaye dakṣiṇāṃ sekuliśāyudhāya namaḥ - kuliśāyuda māvāhayāmi | taddakṣiṇa padadvaye dakṣeṇi bāhau sūryāya namaḥ sūryāṃ āvāhayāmi |
analyzed: śikhine namaḥ śibhina māvāhayāmi tad dakṣiṇa sārdha pade dakṣiṇa netre parḍanyāya namaḥ parjanya māvāhayāmi tad dakṣima pada dvaye dakṣiṇa śotre jayaṃtāya namaḥ jayaṃta māvāhayāmi tad dakṣiṇa pada dvaye dakṣiṇām bāhau sūryāya namaḥ sūryām āvāhayāmi

original: taddakṣiṇa padadvaye dakṣiṇa bāho satyāya namaḥ satyaṃ āvāhayāmi | taddakṣiṇa sārdhapade dakṣiṇa kūrpare bhṛśāyanamaḥ bhṛśaṃ āvāhayāmi | taddakṣiṇa āgneya padārthe dakṣiṇa prabāhau | ākāśāya namaḥ ākāśa māvāhayāmi | tatpaścimātdhe dakṣiṇa prabāhau vāyuve namaḥ vāyumāvāhayāmi |
analyzed: tad dakṣiṇa pada dvaye dakṣiṇa bāho satyāya namaḥ satyam āvāhayāmi tad dakṣiṇa sārdha pade dakṣiṇa kūrpare bhṛśāya namaḥ bhṛśam āvāhayāmi tad dakṣiṇa āgneya padārthe dakṣiṇa prabāhau ākāśāya namaḥ ākāśam āvāhayāmi tad paścima atdhe dakṣiṇa prabāhau vāyuve namaḥ vāyum āvāhayāmi

original: tatpaścima sārdhapade dakṣiṇa maṇibaṃdhe pūṣṇe namaḥ pūṣāṇa māvāhayāmi | tatpaścima padadvaye dakṣiṇapārśve vitadhāya namaḥ vitathaṃ āvāhayāmi | tatpaścima padadvaye dakṣiṇa pārśve gṛhakṣatāya namaḥ gṛhakṣata māvāhayāmi | tatpaścima padadvaye dakṣiṇoraumayāma namaḥ yama māvāhayāmi |
analyzed: tad paścima sārdha pade dakṣiṇa maṇibaṃdhe pūṣṇe namaḥ pūṣāṇa mā āvāhayāmi tad paścima pada dvaye dakṣiṇa pārśve vitadhāya namaḥ vitatham āvāhayāmi tad paścima pada dvaye dakṣiṇa pārśve gṛhakṣatāya namaḥ gṛhakṣata mā āvāhayāmi tad paścima pada dvaye namaḥ yama mā āvāhayāmi

original: tatpaścima padadvaye dakṣiṇajānau gaṃdharvāya namaḥ gaṃdharva māvāhayāmi | tatpaścima sārdhapade dakṣiṇa jaṃghāmāṃ bhṛṃgarājāya namaḥ bhṛṃgarāja māvāhayāmi | tatpaścima naiṛti padārthe dakṣiṇa spicimṛgāya namaḥ mṛgaṃ āvāhayāmi | taduttarārthe pādayoḥ pitṛbhyonamaḥ pitabhṛn āvāhayāmi ||

original: oṃ citpiṃgala hana hana daha daha paca paca sarvajñā jñapaya svāha - iti prajvālvā - jvālinīmudrāṃ pradarśya - vāgīśvarī garbhdhṛtaṃ dhyātvā | oṃ raṃ namaḥ asya homāgneḥ - garbhādāna karma - puṃnavana karma - sīmaṃtonnayana karma - jātakarma - homa devatāgniriti nāmnā nāmakaraṇa karma kalpayāmi namaḥ |
analyzed: om cit piṃgala hana hana daha daha paca paca sarvajñā jñapaya svāhā iti prajvālvā jvālinī mudrām pradarśya vāgīśvarī garbha dhṛtam dhyātvā om raṃ namaḥ asya homa agneḥ garbhādāna karma puṃnavana karma sīmaṃtonnayana karma jātakarma homa devatā agniḥ iti nāmnā nāmakaraṇa karma kalpayāmi namaḥ

original: oṃ raṃ namaḥ devātāgneḥ annaprāśana karma - caulakarma - upavayana karma - godāna karma - vivāha karma kalpayāmi namaḥ - iti tattatkarma bhāvanāyā akṣaratai rabhyarcayet || tataḥ sāmānyārghodakena - deva mūlamaṃtreṇa agniṃ pariṣicya agnimalaṃkṛtya ||
analyzed: om raṃ namaḥ devātā agneḥ annaprāśana karma caula karma upavayana karma godāna karma vivāha karma kalpayāmi namaḥ iti tad tad karma bhāvanāyāḥ akṣara taiḥ abhyarcayet tatas sāmānya argha udakena deva mūlamaṃtreṇa agnim pariṣicya agnim alaṃkṛtya

original: maṃ || oṃ viśvakarman haviṣā vardanena | trātāra miṃdra makṛṇo ravadhvaṃ | tasmai viśassa manamaṃta pūrvīra yamagrau vihvayo yadhāsat | upayāma gṛhīto sīṃdrāyatvā | viśvakarmaṇa eṣate yoniriṃdrā yatvā viśvakarmaṇe || oṃ viśvakarmaṇe namaḥ gaṃgādi paṃcopacārai | nāśayatvaṃ hitān sarvān viśvakarma namostute || iti saṃprārdhya ||

original: uparimekhalāyāṃ, śvetavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ viṣṇu māvāhayet idaṃ - sure || viṣṇo yajña patedepa duṣṭadaitya niṣūdana | vibhoyajñasya rajñārdhaṃ kuṃḍe sannihito bhava || pradhama mekhalāyai viṣṇudaivatyai śvetavarṇā laṃkṛtāyai namaḥ || iti akṣataiḥ saṃpūjya ||

original: tato madhya mekhalāyāṃ, raktavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ, brahmaṇa māvāhayt | oṃ brahmajijñānaṃ - vivaḥ || brahmaṇaṃ paṃcopacārai ssaṃpūjya || haṃsa puṣṭha samārūḍha devadeva gaṇāvṛta | rakṣārdhaṃ mama yajñasya kuḍaṃsmat sannidho bhava | iti madhya mamekhalāyai brahmadaivatvai rakta varṇā laṃkṛtāyai namaḥ |

original: iti saṃpūjya tato adho mekhalāyāṃ, kṛṣṇavarṇā laṃkṛtāyāṃ rudra māvāhya | oṃ namaste rudra - mṛḍaya | gaṃgādhara mahādeva vṛṣārūḍha maheśvara | agaccha bhagavan rudra kuṃḍesmin tsannidobhava | iti tṛtīyamekhalāyai kṛṣṇavarṇā laṃkṛtāyai rudra daivatyai namaḥ | iṃti saṃpūjyaḥ ||

original: suvarṇena yadhāśakyā tattallakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ || pratamāḥ kārayitveva māḍhaka vrīhikasthale | sthaṃḍilaṃ parikalpyātha kuṃbhamauṣadhi saṃyutaṃ || jalaiḥ saṃpūryasaṃsthāpya mṛgādiprakṣipetattataḥ | vastradvayena saṃveṣṭaya paṃcaratnāni nikṣipet || kuṃbhoparisaṃsthāpya ca tasraḥ pratimāstathā | saṃsthāpya tatra maṃtraiśca kramādarceddunettathā ||
analyzed: suvarṇena yadhāśakyā tad tad lakṣaṇa lakṣitāḥ kārayitvā iva māḍhaka vrīhika sthale sthaṃḍilam parikalpya atha kuṃbham auṣadhi saṃyutam jalaiḥ saṃpūrya saṃsthāpya mṛga ādi prakṣipeta tatas vastra dvayena saṃveṣṭaya paṃcaratnāni nikṣipet kuṃbha upari saṃsthāpya ca tasraḥ pratimāḥ tathā saṃsthāpya tatra maṃtraiḥ ca kramāt arcet dunet tathā

original: samiccaru ghṛtadravyaiḥ pratyekaṃ ca yathākramaṃ | ṛtvigbhiśca sahacāryohu nedaṣṭasahasrakaṃ || aṣṭottaraśataṃ nātha aṣṭaviṃśatimenavā | tata stilairhuneddevān tattanmaṃtraiśca kṛtyavit || tatobhiṣe ca yoddānaṃ maṃtraiḥ paurāṇikaiḥ kramāt | prīyātāṃ bhagavānīśaḥ pinākī sarvatomukhaḥ || tamamurtipradānena mama pāpaṃ vināśaya |
analyzed: samidh caru ghṛta dravyaiḥ pratyekam ca yathākramam ṛtvigbhiḥ ca ned aṣṭa sahasrakam aṣṭottaraśatam nātha aṣṭaviṃśatim enavā tatas tilaiḥ hunet devān tad tad maṃtraiḥ ca kṛtya vid ca yā uddānam maṃtraiḥ paurāṇikaiḥ kramāt prīyātām bhagavān īśaḥ pinākī sarvatomukhaḥ tam amurti pradānena mama pāpam vināśaya

original: daṃṣṭrākarālavadano nīlāṃjana samūkṛtiḥ | raktākṣosigadāpāṇi rmṛtyormāṃ pāpi sarvadā || dānamevaṃ vidhairmaṃtr ryathāvidhi samāhitaḥ | go bhū hiraṇya vastrśca ācāryaṃ pūjayotsudhīḥ || evaṃ kuryādvidhā nena viṣadoṣaḥ praśāmyati || iti ghaṭikāśāṃtiḥ ||
analyzed: daṃṣṭrā karāla vadanaḥ mṛtyoḥ mām pāpi sarvadā dānam evam vidhaiḥ maṃtr yathāvidhi samāhitaḥ ācāryam pūjaya utsudhīḥ evam kuryāt vidhā nena viṣa doṣaḥ praśāmyati iti ghaṭikāśāṃtiḥ

original: atha tithi prasavaśāṃtiḥ || tatra kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jāta śāṃtiḥ || prayoga pārijāte gargaḥ || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ prasūteṣaḍvidhaṃ phalaṃ | caturdaśīṃ ca ṣaḍbhāgaṃ kuryādādau śubhaṃ smṛtaṃ || dvitīyaḥ pitaraṃ haṃti tṛtī yo mātaraṃ tathā | caturdho mātulaṃ haṃti paṃcame vaṃśa nāśanaṃ || ṣaṣṭheca dhanahāni ssyādātmano vaṃśanāśanaṃ |
analyzed: atha tithi prasavaśāṃtiḥ tatra kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jāta śāṃtiḥ prayoga pārijāte gargaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyām prasūteṣaḍvidham phalam caturdaśīm ca ṣaḍbhāgam kuryāt ādau śubham smṛtam dvitīyaḥ pitaram haṃti tṛtīyaḥ mātaram tathā caturdhaḥ mātulam haṃti paṃcame vaṃśa nāśanam ṣaṣṭhe ca dhana hāniḥ syāt ātmanaḥ vaṃśa nāśanam

original: yasmātsarva prayatnena śāṃtiṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ || ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvitta śāṭhya kuryādi dhānataḥ || ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvi dhanātaḥ ||
analyzed: yasmāt sarva prayatnena śāṃtim kuryāt vi dhānataḥ ācārya m ṛtvijaḥ vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakam rudra ādi devatām tasmāt karṣa mātra suvarṇataḥ tad ardā dhenavā kuryāt vitta śāṭhya kuryāt vitta śāṭhya kuryāt vi dhānataḥ ācārya m ṛtvijaḥ vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakam rudra ādi devatām tasmāt karṣa mātra suvarṇataḥ tad ardā dhenavā kuryāt vi dhanātaḥ

original: ācārya mṛtvijo vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakaṃ | rudrādi devatāṃ stasmātkarṣamātra suvarṇataḥ || tadardādhenavā kuryādvitta śāṭhya vivarjitaḥ | pratimāṃ kāraye ccaṃbho | sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutāṃ || vṛṣabheca samāsīnaṃ varadābhaya pāṇinaṃ | śuddha sphatika saṃkāśaṃ śvetamālyāṃbarānnitaṃ | triyaṃbakākhya maṃtreṇa pūjāṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ |
analyzed: ācārya m ṛtvijaḥ vṛtvā svasti vācana pūrvakam rudra ādi devatām kuryāt vitta śāṭhya vivarjitaḥ pratimām kārayet caṃbho sarva lakṣaṇa saṃyutām vṛṣabhe ca samāsīnam vara da abhaya pāṇim śuddha sphatika saṃkāśam śveta mālya ambara annitam tryaṃbaka ākhya maṃtreṇa pūjām kuryāt vi dhānataḥ

original: sthāpaye ccaturaḥ kuṃbhān vidikṣu ca yadhāvidhi | āgneyī mārabhya vidikṣvityarthaḥ || āgneyaṃ kuṃbha mārabhye tyagre darśanāt || puṇyatīrdha jalopetān dhānyasmo parisyaset || tanmadhyesthāpayetkuṃbhaṃ śatacchidra samanvitaṃ | paṃca mṛtpaṃca ratnāni paṃcatva kpaṃca pallavān || paṃca dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃca tattasmaṃtrai rvinikṣi pet ||
analyzed: sthāpayet caturaḥ kuṃbhān vidikṣu ca yadhāvidhi āgneyīm ārabhya vidikṣu iti arthaḥ āgneyam kuṃbham ārabhya iti agre darśanāt tad madhye sthāpayet kuṃbham śata chidra samanvitam paṃca mṛd paṃca ratnāni paṃca pallavān paṃca dhānyam suvarṇam ca tat tad maṃtraiḥ vinikṣipet

original: śatauṣadhāni nikṣipya śveta vastraśca veṣṭayet || surabhīṇica puṣpāṇi śvetāni pariveṣayet | sarve samudrā ssarita stīrdhāni jaladānadāḥ || āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣaya kārakāḥ | āvāhya vāruṇai rmaṃttr ranenaca vidhānataḥ || imaṃmme varuṇe tyanayā tatvāyā mītivātathā | tvanno agne ityanayā
analyzed: śata auṣadhāni nikṣipya śveta vastraḥ ca veṣṭayet surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi śvetāni pariveṣayet sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ tīrdhāni jalada dānadāḥ āyāṃtu yajamānasya durita kṣaya kārakāḥ āvāhya vāruṇaiḥ vidhānataḥ imam me varuṇe tyanayā tatvāyāḥ tvat naḥ agne ityanayā

original: satvanna iti maṃtrataḥ || ānobhadrākhya sūktaṃca bhadrā agneśca sūktakaṃ | japtyātu puruṣasūktaṃ kadrudraṃtu kramājjapet || īśvarasyābhiṣekaṃca graha pūjāṃca kārayet | pūjāṃ karmasu nirvṛtya homaṃ kuryādhvi dhānataḥ || grahasyeśāna digbhāge kuṃḍaṃ kuryā dvidhānataḥ | vistārā yāmakhātaṃ cāpyaratnadvaya saṃmmitaṃ ||
analyzed: iti maṃtrataḥ ānobhadra ākhya sūktam ca bhadrāḥ agneḥ ca sūktakam japtyā tu puruṣasūktam kadrudram tu kramāt japet īśvarasya abhiṣekam ca graha pūjām ca kārayet pūjām karmasu nirvṛtya homam kuryāt dhānataḥ grahasya īśāna digbhāge kuṃḍam kuryāḥ dvidhānataḥ vistārāḥ yāma khātam ca api aratna dvaya saṃmitam

original: kuṃḍa kaṃṭhaṃ piratyajya samaṃtā daṃgulaṃ kramāt | mekhalocchrāya vistārau catustrī dvyaṃgulaiḥ kramāt || paścime madhyabhāgetu yoniṃ kuryādvi dhānataḥ || yoniṃ ṣaḍaṃgulyāṃ tiryagdvā daśāṃguladairghikāṃ | aśvaththadala saṃkāśāṃ kiṃcinni mnāyatāṃ śubhāṃ || kuryā dāghāra paryaṃtaṃ svagṛhyokta vidhānataḥ |
analyzed: kuṃḍa kaṃṭham kramāt mekhalā ucchrāya vistārau dvi aṃgulaiḥ kramāt paścime madhyabhāge tu yonim kuryāt vi dhānataḥ yonim ṣaṣ aṃgulyām tiryak dvā daśa aṃgula dairghikām aśvaththa dala saṃkāśām kiṃcid ni mnāyatām śubhām kuryāḥ sva gṛhya ukta vidhānataḥ

original: samidhājyaṃcaruṃcaiva tilimāṣāmaśca sarṣapaiḥ || sarṣapaiḥ sahitā tila māṣā ityardhaḥ || aśvaddha plakṣapālāśa samidbhiḥ khādiraiḥ śubhaiḥ || aṣṭottara sahasraṃvā aṣṭottara śataṃ tuvā | aṣṭāviṃśati retaiśca homaṃ kuryātprudhak‌ pṛthak || triyaṃbakena maṃtreṇa tilān vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt || graha evaṃca hotavyā - asmadukta vidhānataḥ |
analyzed: samidhā ājyam carum ca eva sarṣapaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ sahitā tila māṣāḥ iti ardhaḥ plakṣa pālāśa samidbhiḥ khādiraiḥ śubhaiḥ aṣṭottara sahasram vā aṣṭottara śatam aṣṭāviṃśati retaiḥ ca homam kuryāt prudhak pṛthak triyaṃbakena maṃtreṇa tilān vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt graha evam ca hotavyāḥ asmad ukta vidhānataḥ

original: evaṃ krameṇa hutvādhā homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || sarvālaṃkāra yuktānā trayāṇā mabhiṣe canaṃ || trayo mātā pitṛ bālāḥ || caturbhiḥ kalaśairadbhiḥ bṛhatkuṃbha samanvitaṃ - bṛhatkuṃbhaṃ śatacchidraṃ || dautāṃairāṇi dhṛtvātha kuryā dājyāvalokanaṃ || pūrṇahutiṃ juhuyā dyajamāna samannitaḥ || tatsarvaṃ parāyā bhaktyā īśvarāya nivedayet |
analyzed: evam krameṇa hutvā adhā homa śeṣam samāpayet sarva alaṃkāra yuktānā trayāṇām trayaḥ mātā pitṛ bālāḥ caturbhiḥ kalaśaiḥ adbhiḥ bṛhat kuṃbha samanvitam bṛhat kuṃbham śata chidram dhṛtvā atha kuryāt ājya avalokanam pūrṇahutim juhuyāt yajamāna samannitaḥ tat sarvam parāyā bhaktyā īśvarāya nivedayet

original: sarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktāṃ savatsāṃgāṃ payasvīnīṃ || pratimāṃ vastrayugmaṃ cāpyā cāryaya nivedayet | īśvara prītaye śaktyā karyādbrāhmaṇa bhojanaṃ evaṃ yaḥ kurute śāṃtiṃ sarvapāpaiḥ prayucyate sarvānkāmāna vāpnoti sthirajīvī sukhī bhavet ||
analyzed: sarva alaṃkāra saṃyuktām sa vatsa aṃgām payasvīnīm pratimām vastra yugmam nivedayet īśvara prītaye śaktyā nivedayet īśvara prītaye śaktyā evam yaḥ kurute śāṃtim sarva pāpaiḥ prayucyate sarvān kāmān vāpnoti sthira jīvī sukhī bhavet
iti kṛṣṇa caturṣaśī śāṃtiḥ

original: atha prayogaḥ || kartā pitrādyariṣṭādau gomukha prasavaṃ kṛtā | deśakālau saṃkīrtyā asaya bālakasya kṛṣṇa caturdaśī janma sūcitāriṣṭa nirasana dvārā parameśvara prītyardhaṃ sanava grahaṃ makha garbitaṃ kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jananaśāṃtiṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya || gaṇeśapūjā puṇyāhavācana nāṃdī śrāddācārya tvrīgvaraṇāni kuryāt |
analyzed: atha prayogaḥ kartā pitṛ ādi ariṣṭa ādau gomukha prasavam kṛtā deśa kālau saṃkīrtyā bālakasya kṛṣṇa caturdaśī janma sūcita ariṣṭa nirasana dvārā parameśvara prītyardham sanava graham makha garbitam kṛṣṇa caturdaśī jananaśāṃtim kariṣye iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśa pūjā puṇyāha vācana nāṃdī śrāddha ācārya kuryāt

original: tataḥ ācāryaḥ āgneyādi vidikṣu caturaḥ kuṃbhānmadhyeca śatacchidre paṃcamṛdaḥ paṃca pallavān paṃcaratnāni paṃcatvacaḥ paṃcadhānyāni suvarṇaṃ satauṣadhīśca nikṣipya vastr rmalyaiścaveṣṭa yitvā || pūrṇapātre karṣata darthārda kṛtāṃ rudra pratimāṃ - triyaṃbakamiti maṃtreṇa saṃpūjya āgneyādi koṇeṣu kaṃbhān saṃsthāpya ||
analyzed: tatas ācāryaḥ āgneya ādi vidikṣu caturaḥ kuṃbhān madhye ca śata chidre paṃcamṛdaḥ paṃca pallavān paṃca ratnāni paṃca tvacaḥ paṃca dhānyāni suvarṇam sata oṣadhīḥ ca nikṣipya vastram sata oṣadhīḥ ca nikṣipya vastram kṛtām rudra pratimām tryaṃbakam iti maṃtreṇa saṃpūjya āgneya ādi koṇeṣu kaṃbhān saṃsthāpya

original: imaṃmme - tatvāyāmi - tvanno āgne || sarve samudrā ssarita stīrthāni jalamānadāḥ | āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣaya kārakāḥ || āgneyādi koṇastha kalaśa pratimāsu imaṃmme ityādi tri bhirmaṃ taiḥ sarve samudrā iti varuṇaṃ ca saṃpūjya rudraṃ paṃca śāṃtiṃ anobhadrā - bhadrāgneḥ sahasra śīrṣāṃ - kadrudrāya āyustūktāni japet ||
analyzed: imaṃmme tatvāyāmi tvat naḥ āgne sarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ tīrthāni jala mānadāḥ āyāṃtu yajamānasya durita kṣaya kārakāḥ āgneya ādi koṇa stha kalaśa pratimāsu imaṃmme ityādi tri bhiḥ maṃ taiḥ sarve samudrāḥ iti varuṇam ca saṃpūjya rudram paṃca śāṃtim anobhadrāḥ bhadrāgneḥ sahasra śīrṣām kadrudrāya āyus tu uktāni japet

original: tatogre grahaṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ ca kṛtvā samidvaya mādāyaca kṣuṣyaṃtetra pradānaṃ rudra maśvattha plakṣa palāśa khādira samidājya carutila māṣa sarṣapa dravyaiḥ pratyeka maṣṭa sahasra maṣṭaśata maṣṭāviṃśati vāraṃvā tryaṃbaka
analyzed: tatas ugre grahaṇām sthāpanam ca kṛtvā samidh vayam ādāya ca pradānam

original: maṃtreṇa prajāpatiṃ vyastābhi ssamasatavyāhṛtibhiḥ sahasmādi saṃkhyayā tila dravyeṇa śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛta mityādi krameṇa nirvāpādi nācaruṃ kṛtvā sācārya tvrijo homādi bali dānāṃte śata cchidreṇa caturbhiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ graha kuṃbhaiścābhiṣiṃceyuḥ ||
analyzed: maṃtreṇa prajāpatim vyastābhiḥ sahasma ādi saṃkhyayā tila dravyeṇa śeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛtam ityādi krameṇa nirvāpa ādi nā carum kṛtvā sa ācārya homa ādi bali dāna aṃte śata chidreṇa caturbhiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ graha kuṃbhaiḥ ca abhiṣiṃceyuḥ

original: tato yajamāno vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvā kāṃsyapātre rūpaṃ rūpa mityājyaṃ sakuṭuṃbo valokya sadakṣiṇaṃ saprātaṃ ācāryāyagāṃ vastrayugamṛtvigbhyaśca dakṣiṇāṃ ca datvā viprān saṃbhojya karma rudrārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhuṃjīteti ||
analyzed: tatas yajamānaḥ vibhūtim dhṛtvā kāṃsya pātre rūpam rūpa miti ājyam sa kuṭuṃbaḥ valokya sa dakṣiṇam sa prātar ācāryāya gām vastra yugam ṛtvigbhyaḥ ca dakṣiṇām ca da tvā viprān saṃbhojya karma rudra arpaṇam kṛtvā bhuṃjīta iti

original: iti śrī kamalākara kṛta kṛṣṇa caturdaśī śāṃti prayogaḥ ||
analyzed: iti śrī kamalākara kṛta kṛṣṇa caturdaśī śāṃti prayogaḥ

original: atha sinīvālikuhū śāṃtiḥ || prayoga pārijāte uttaragargyaḥ || sinīvālyāṃ pranūtāsya ddāsībhāryā paśustadhā | gajāśva mahiṣīcaiva śakrasyāpi śrīyaṃ haret || kuhūprasūti ratyardhaṃ sarvadoṣakarīsmṛtā | yasya prasūtireteṣāṃ tasyāyurdhana nāśanaṃ || sarvagaṃḍa samastatra doṣastuprabalo bhavet || śāṃtaṃvinā viśeṣeṇa parityāgo navidyate |
analyzed: atha sinīvāli kuhū śāṃtiḥ prayoga pārijāte uttaragargyaḥ sinīvālyām haret kuhū prasūti rati ardham sarva doṣa karī smṛtā yasya prasūtiḥ eteṣām tasya āyuḥ dhana nāśanam sarvagaṃḍa samaḥ tatra doṣaḥ tu prabalaḥ bhavet śāṃtam vinā viśeṣeṇa parityāgaḥ na vidyate

original: parityāge tatra kāryaeva | śāṃtiṃ kuryāddhīmān vicakṣaṇaiḥ || śāṃtau kṛtāmāmapi tyāgaḥ kāryaeva | śāṃtiṃ vinātu sutarāṃ tyāga ityarthaḥ || satyajetpaṃḍitomohā darthādajñānatopivā | śāṃtiṃ vinaiva bālaṃtu satyajedityādi vacanādityarthyaḥ || tadyogānnāśaye tkiṃci tvvayaṃvā nāśamaśnute | bālayogādityardhyaḥ ||

original: pūrākalpāśa sānetu kalpasyāsya samudbhave || āririppsuryadhā sṛṣṭiṃ śruti smṛti vidhirvidhiḥ || sasmārata nayāsapta manasān prajā patiḥ | teyadā tapasākliśyanna śekussṛṣṭi sādhane || śivamārādhya tapasā prasannaṃ samāyācire || prajāmeva prajākāmāḥ prajāpati sutāstute || bhagavaṃ stapa sākhinnāḥ prajāpeto prajāpateḥ ||

original: ākarma pacanānmohādvārā niṣpalalakṣaṇāt || tatohina prajāsiddhi rasmākaṃ śiva jāyāte || prajārdhaṃtvāṃ prapannāsmsa būhita tsiddhikṛdvidhaṃ || prārditastu tadā śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ dyātvā bravīccatān || śṛṇudhvaṃmunaya ssarve prajā yāyada saṃbhave || kāraṇaṃmunaya ssarve yuddṛṣṭaṃ jñāna cakṣuṣā | anapatyakaraṃ karmacakreya tpūrva saṃplave ||
analyzed: pacanāt mohāt vārā saṃplave

original: kāle bhuktāva śeṣeyat daurbāgya tadduvaṃ tanau || viluptamanu maṃtrādi bhedabhinnaṃ dvayorapi || vālasaikenata ddehāyugalaṃ paridhāyaca | kurudhvaṃ vidhi vatsnānaṃ tathā daurbhāgya nāśanaṃ || ānakhā grācchake śāṃtaṃ yāvadaṃgaṃ viśukravat || eva māyati daurbhāgyaṃ paṃcadhāyatprakīrtitaṃ || tasya śayyāsana vidhiḥ sahapratyaika vāsasā ||
analyzed: tanau viluptam anu maṃtra ādi bheda bhinnam dvayoḥ api maṃtra ādi bheda bhinnam dvayoḥ api paridhāya ca kurudhvam daurbhāgya nāśanam śāntam yāvat aṃgam viśukra vat eva daurbhāgyam paṃcadhā yat prakīrtitam tasya śayyā āsana vidhiḥ tasya śayyā āsana vidhiḥ

original: snātvā samyake videḥ putrāḥ saṃtateḥ śreya apsyatha || ityuktvāntarhite śaṃbhāva kurvanmunayaścaha || yathaika vasanasnāna māditaḥ sumahadvidhiṃ || yadhā śatṛṃyathādṛṣṭaṃ śrutibhyo jñāna cakṣuṣā || śubhamāsesite pakṣe sānukūle grahedine ||
analyzed: snātvā putrāḥ saṃtateḥ śreyaḥ apsyatha iti uktvā antarhite śaṃbhāva kurvan munayaḥ ca ha yathā eka vasana snāna māditas su mahat vidhim yadhā śrutibhyaḥ jñāna cakṣuṣā pakṣe sa anukūle grahedine

original: nadanadyoḥ samāyoga mahānadyordhva yodapi pratyuṣe siddhi māsthāya śarīrasya yathāvidhi || vidhiṃ vividha māsthāya patnyā saha marhaṇāṃ || vidhāya śraddayā yukto maṃtrayetamudīrayet || karmasārtri jagannādha yanmayā pūrva janmani || paṃcathā patyadaḥkhākhya daurbhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet || prāptastasya vināśāya vidhikalpa manuttamaṃ ||
analyzed: samāyoga mahā nadyā ūrdhva siddhi māsthāya śarīrasya yathāvidhi vidhim āsthāya patnyā saha marhaṇām vidhāya śraddayā yuktaḥ maṃtrayeta mudīrayet karma sārtri jagannādha yat mayā pūrva janmani paṃcathā daurbhāgyam atulam bhavet prāptaḥ tasya vināśāya vidhi kalpa manuttamam

original: sahapatnyā dināvādha tatra siddhiṃ prayacchame || evamucyārya tadvāstra mahataṃ dvidaśātmakaṃ || sārdahasta dvayā yāmaṃ paṃcaviṃśa karonnataṃ || vitatma taṃtubhiḥ ślakṣṇestanmadhyenyūta madbhutaṃ | yūvāsuvāsā maṃtreṇa maṃtritaṃ daiva vedisā || samyaddattaṃ tadādāya paridha dhyātsavastrakaṃ || dṛḍhānī virabhinnācade hetri higuṇīkṛtaṃ ||
analyzed: saha patnyā tatra siddhim tatra siddhim

original: tacchaiṣā ddakṣiṇāṃgasthāsa patnīkaṃ suputrikā || paridadhyātprayatnena saṃvṛtta vamamastakā || kuśānsaṃmṛjya saṃgopya yātipṛṣṭhānugāminī upaviśva jalasthānetāvṛbhauvapidaṃ patī || prakṣālya pāṇipādauca svācāṃtau mamasanmakhau || vaidikān laukikāṃścāpi sāvadānaujiteṃdriyau || tīrthatvamapi sarneṣāṃ devanāmigraṇīḥ prabhuḥ |
analyzed: patnīkam suputrikā paridadhyāt prayatnena suputrikā paridadhyāt prayatnena kuśān saṃmṛjya saṃgopya patī prakṣālya pāṇi pādau ca su ācāṃtau vaidikān laukikān ca api sa avadāna ojita iṃdriyau tīrtha tvam api prabhuḥ

original: jīvanaṃ sarva jaṃtūnāṃ garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || yāniyānīha pāpāni anapatya karāṇinau | hatvātānyakhilānīśa garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || yadāvābhyāṃ mahatpāpaṃ purājanmani duḥkhataḥ || kṛtaṃtanme vinirbhūya garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho || tvavaivādhiṣṭitā ssarvenadīnada jalāśrayāḥ || punaṃti pāpinaḥ varvān garbhaṃ dehi mamaprabho ||
analyzed: jīvanam sarva jaṃtūnām garbham dehi mamaprabho yāni yāni iha pāpāni anapatya karāṇinau hatvā tāni akhilāni īśa garbham dehi mamaprabho yadā āvābhyām mahat pāpam purā janmani duḥkhataḥ kṛtam tat me vinirbhūya garbham dehi mamaprabho punaṃti pāpinaḥ garbham dehi mamaprabho

original: āśāsmahe mahābhāge saṃtatiṃ lokapāvanīṃ || pasannādbhavataḥ svāmin garbhadehi mamaprabho || bhūtapreta piśācādyāyo nausaṃtati vighnidāḥ || pāśenāhṛtyatān sarvān garbhaṃdehi mamaprabho || evaṃ saṃprārthyātā āpaḥ daṃpatītau balādbahiḥ || susnāya prājñmukhaḥ stiṣṭhenmaṃtraṃ suśrāvayediti ||
analyzed: āśāsmahe mahābhāge saṃtatim loka pāvanīm svāmin garbha dehi mama prabho bhūta preta piśāca ādi ayaḥ nau saṃtati vighni dāḥ pāśena āhṛtya tān sarvān garbham dehi mama prabho evam saṃprārthyātāḥ āpaḥ balāt bahis su snāya prājñmukhaḥ stiṣṭhet maṃtram su śrāvayet iti
imā maṃgīrasa

original: ādatyobhyodvaya mimaṃ śubhaṃ || śrāvayānbhuvi vinyapātraṃta tpraṇa mecchamāṃ || tatonyevāsasī śubhre śucinī parithāyatau || upa viśvāsane śubhre puṇya srakcraṃda nārcitā || tatassa kanakaṃ sarpispraśeta marabhīṃdvijan || praṇīpatya tataḥ śeṣaṃ karma sarvaṃ samāpayet || ācāryastu vidhānena daivajñenānu moditaḥ ||
analyzed: mimam śubham śrāvayān bhuvi tatas śeṣam karma sarvam samāpayet ācāryaḥ tu vidhānena daivajñena anu moditaḥ

original: hastamātre tatastatra sthiṃḍile kalaśaṃnyaset || avraṇaṃ payasā pūrṇaṃ svarṇa puṣpakṣatairyutaṃ || pūrṇa pātraṃnyase tatra pūrṇaṃ puṣpaphalākṣataiḥ | svasva maṃtraiḥ pratiṣṭhāvya māheśa mumayānaha || tasyāgre prajapeyuste brahmaṇāṃ maṃtrakevidaḥ | paṃcāṃgādvidhi vanmaṃbhatrān rudrasūktaiśca yājaṣaiḥ udvāsyāthacaruṃ samyagācāryaḥ svavidhānataḥ |
analyzed: hasta mātre tatas tatra sthiṃḍile kalaśam nyaset avraṇam payasā pūrṇam svarṇa puṣpa kṣataiḥ yutam pūrṇa pātram nyase tatra pūrṇam puṣpa phala akṣataiḥ sva sva maṃtraiḥ pratiṣṭhāvya māheśa mumayān aha tasya agre prajapeyuḥ te brahmaṇām maṃtra kevidaḥ paṃcāṃgāt vidhi rudrasūktaiḥ ca yājaṣaiḥ udvāsya atha carum samyak ācāryaḥ sva vidhānataḥ

original: āghārāvājya bhāgauca hutvā vāhyanibhāvasuṃ || dikpatīnparitaḥ pūjya sasva maṃtraissamā hitaḥ | prajāpate rathāgneyāṃ garbhaṃdhehi ticāparāṃ | apāṃ pṛṣṭhāṃ tathā hotā imaṃme saptavāruṇaṃ || tataḥ sviṣṭa kṛtaṃ hutvā karma śeṣaṃ samācaret || homāṃte śiva mabhyarca saśivaṃ vidhipūrvakaṃ | japaṃ homaṃ nivedyāsmai vidhivatvija kovidaḥ ||
analyzed: āghārau ājya bhāgau ca hutvā vāhya nibhāvasum dikpatīn paritas pūjya sasva maṃtraiḥ samā hitaḥ prajāpate ratha āgneyām garbham dhehi apām pṛṣṭhām tathā hotā imam me saptavāruṇam tatas su iṣṭa kṛtam hutvā karma śeṣam samācaret homa aṃte sa śivam vidhi pūrvakam japam homam nivedya asmai kovidaḥ

original: tato viprāya viduṣe nuśāṃtāya payasvinīṃ | savastra dakṣiṇopetāṃ savatsāṃ dhenumuttamāṃ | tathālaṃkṛta sarvāgaṃ
analyzed: tatas viprāya viduṣe nuśāṃtāya payasvinīm dakṣiṇā upetām sa vatsām dhenum uttamām

original: vṛṣabhaṃ śubha lakṣaṇaṃ || datvādau daṃpatī paścāddaivajñenānapa moditau || maṃtra muccārayodtāṃ vaividhipadvi hitārvāṇaiḥ || devadeva jagannādha sarvapāpaughanāśana || karmaṇānena dānena tathā goyugalasyatu || saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ bhūtvā saṃtatiṃ dhehimeprabho || tatastu vaiṇapaṃ pātraṃ śivasyāgre nivedayet ||
analyzed: vṛṣabham śubha lakṣaṇam da tvā ādau daṃpatī paścāt moditau maṃtra hita arvāṇaiḥ devadeva jagannādha sarva pāpa ogha nāśana karmaṇā anena dānena tathā go yugalasya tu saṃtuṣṭaḥ satatam bhūtvā saṃtatim dhehi me prabho tatas tu vaiṇapam pātram śivasya agre nivedayet

original: ācāryāya pradeyā nidānāni nijaśaktitaḥ | guravevāsasīdatvā karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | praṇamya devatābhyaśca visṛjyica vidhānataḥ | tataḥ kuṃbhāṃbhasā viprā abhyaṣiṃceyurādṛtāḥ || maṃtraiśca vāruṇai ssauraiḥ śāṃti svastyayanādibhi || paurāṇairāga moktaistu nānāphala vidāyinaḥ || naṃdīmukhena vidhinātataḥ śrāddaṃ samārabhet ||
analyzed: ācāryāya pradeyā nidānāni nija śaktitaḥ karma śeṣam samāpayet praṇamya devatābhyaḥ ca vidhānataḥ tatas kuṃbha aṃbhasā viprāḥ abhyaṣiṃceyuḥ ādṛtāḥ maṃtraiḥ ca vāruṇaiḥ śāṃti svastyayana ādibhiḥ paurāṇaiḥ āgama uktaiḥ tu nānā phala vidāyinaḥ naṃdīmukhena vidhinā tatas śrāddam samārabhet

original: namova iti maṃtreṇa samaskāra mudīrayet || saptatetāṃtrikā maṃtrāḥ chāṃdasāḥ paṃcavāruṇāḥ || tvaṃ naḥ prabhṛtayo mantrā vāruṇau cāvarāvapi | tvanno agne satvanno agne dveime tatvāyāmi cetyādyairvāruṇa sūktakaiḥ etaṃ tajjalamā maṃtryastutvā maṃtraiḥ praṇamyaca || nimajyonmajyaca punastaṃtra snānaṃ samācaret ||
analyzed: namaḥ vaḥ iti maṃtreṇa samaskāram udīrayet maṃtrāḥ chāṃdasāḥ paṃca vāruṇāḥ tvam naḥ prabhṛtayaḥ mantrāḥ vāruṇau ca avarau api tvat naḥ agne dve ime ca ityādyaiḥ vāruṇa sūktakaiḥ etam maṃtryaḥ tutvā maṃtraiḥ praṇamya ca nimajya unmajya ca punar taṃtra snānam samācaret

original: prayogaṃ vidhiva vatkṛtvā putrakāma samṛddhaye | snāsyāmahe sabhagavān prajetānau prasīdatu || snāyī yātāṃ tataḥ snānaṃ dravyairmaṃtrābhi maṃtritaiḥ || mṛtsnāgomaya gomūtrerdra vyairdadhipayo ghṛtaiḥ || tilāmalaka piṣṭaiśca sarvauṣadhi kuśodakaiḥ || nivṛtya vidhivatsnānaṃdaṃ patītā vubhauvapi || snāpitaiva tataḥ patnī ekaika dyavya saṃcayaiḥ ||
analyzed: prayogam putra kāma samṛddhaye snāsyāmahe sa bhagavān prajetānau prasīdatu snāyī yātām tatas snānam dravyaiḥ maṃtra abhi maṃtritaiḥ mṛtsnā gomaya go mūtreḥ dra vyaiḥ dadhi payaḥ ghṛtaiḥ tila āmalaka piṣṭaiḥ ca sarva oṣadhi kuśa udakaiḥ nivṛtya vidhivat snānaṃdam snāpitā eva tatas patnī ekaika dyavya saṃcayaiḥ

original: auduṃbaraṃ bahu phaliṃbibhratī nijamūrdhani || maṃtrapūrvaṃ nvapatinā dattāṃ śākhāṃ prajānvitāṃ | saptauṣidhi susaṃ pūrṇaiḥ kalaśai rathasaptabhiḥ || maṃtrapūtaiḥ sadaivajñaḥ snāpayetāṃ vidhānataḥ || vardā karaścarāsnāca sahādevīśatāvarī || paṃcailā lakṣmaṇācet saptauṣadyobhiṣecane | yājātā anuvākastu saptauṣadyabhiṣecane ||
analyzed: auduṃbaram bahu phalim bibhratī nija mūrdhani maṃtra pūrvam dattām śākhām prajā anvitām sapta oṣidhi su sam pūrṇaiḥ kalaśaiḥ ratha saptabhiḥ maṃtra pūtaiḥ sa daiva jñaḥ snāpayetām vidhānataḥ vardā karaḥ ca rāsnā ca sahādevī śatāvarī paṃcailā lakṣmaṇā ced sapta auṣadyaḥ abhiṣecane yā ajātāḥ anuvākaḥ tu saptauṣadyabhiṣecane

original: tatastu vaiṇavaṃ pātraṃ saptadhānyopa saṃbhṛtaṃ || mudga taṃḍula godhūma yava śāli samanvitaiḥ || sakaṃgu sahamāṣaiśca dhānyairitica saptabhiḥ || palāni vinyase ttatrayāḥ palinīriti maṃtrataḥ || nārikelaṃca nāruṃgaṃdāḍi maṃbīja pūrakaṃ uttathī matha pūgaṃca jaṃbīraṃ tātra saptamaṃ |
analyzed: tatas tu vaiṇavam pātram saptadhānya upa saṃbhṛtam mudga taṃḍula godhūma yava śāli samanvitaiḥ sa kaṃgu saha māṣaiḥ ca dhānyaiḥ iti ca saptabhiḥ palāni vinyaset palinīḥ iti maṃtrataḥ nārikelam ca pūrakam pūgaṃca jaṃbīram saptamam

original: laukikaistuta maṃtraiśca pūrvoktai reva saptabhiḥ śirometyama vākena snānaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ prāguva sthitaṃ | paudāguṣṭhā dānakhāgrādāke śāṃtaṃ samutpṛjet || sanāne nānename devatāṃ tsarvānapasāraya || iti vijñapya varuṇaṃ māṃca karmādi sākṣiṇaṃ || ekacitta ssmareddeva mumayā sahitaṃ śivaṃ || tatastvetāneva devān manuṣyān sahapūrvajaiḥ ||
analyzed: laukikaiḥ tu te maṃtraiḥ ca saptabhiḥ snānam daurbhāgyam sthitam samutpṛjet devatām sarvān apasāraya iti vijñapya varuṇam mām ca karma ādi sākṣiṇam ekacittaḥ smaret deva mumayā sahitam śivam tatas tu etān eva devān manuṣyān saha pūrvajaiḥ

original: nāṃdī mukhena vidhinā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ | vibhrāḍityanuvākena phala puṣpāṃkṣa tāṃjaliḥ || upasthāya tataḥ paścātkarma śeṣaṃ samāpayet || tatastaddvaiṣṇaṃ pātraṃ śirasyādhāya yoṣitaḥ | kuśāgreṇa samālabhya vaṭhenmaṃtrān suśāṃtikān | tataḥ svastyayanāyaiva śāṃtayeca muhurmuhuḥ || madhyamamaṃ piṃḍamaśnāti patnī daivajña coditā |
analyzed: nāṃdī mukhena vidhinā saṃtarpya pitṛ devatāḥ vibhrāj iti anuvākena phala puṣpa aṃkṣa ta aṃjaliḥ upasthāya tatas paścāt karma śeṣam samāpayet tatas tat dvaiṣṇam pātram śirasi ādhāya yoṣitaḥ kuśa agreṇa samālabhya vaṭhet maṃtrān su śāṃtikān tatas svastyayanāya eva śāṃtaye ca muhur muhur madhyamamam piṃḍam aśnāti patnī daivajña coditā

original: adhatta pitaro garbhamiti maṃtreṇa matritaṃ | ācamya nidhivatpaścātkarmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || śataṃcabhojanayedanyān dvijān saṃtoṣya śaktitaḥ || kṛtakṛtyauca tausyātāṃ putra pautra sukhānvitau ||
analyzed: adhatta pitaraḥ garbham iti maṃtreṇa matritam ācamya nidhivat paścāt karma śeṣam samāpayet śatam ca bhojanayet anyān dvijān saṃtoṣya śaktitaḥ kṛtakṛtyau ca tau syātām putra pautra sukha anvitau
iti sūryāruṇa saṃvāde ekavastra snāna vidhiḥ

original: adṅutasāgare dharmaśāstra nibaṃdhane gargaḥ | ūrdhvaṃviṃśati varṣāttu madho bhavativāraṇe | tadarvāgya dimādyeta svāmino maraṇaṃdiśet | kārayettatraśāṃtiṃca brāhmaṇāṃścāpi tarpayat | ekarātrokṣita ssnātvā priyaḥ prayatamānasaḥ | aṣṭottara sahasraṃtu maṃtraṃcāpi japeccuciḥ | tataḥ prajyapya maṃtrestu salilaṃcābhi matraṃyet |
analyzed: dharma śāstra nibaṃdhane gargaḥ ūrdhvam viṃśati varṣāt tu bhavati vāraṇe svāminaḥ maraṇam diśet kārayet tatra śāṃtim ca brāhmaṇān ca api tarpayat eka rātra ukṣitaḥ snātvā priyaḥ prayata mānasaḥ aṣṭottara sahasram tu maṃtram ca api japet cuciḥ tatas prajyapya maṃtreḥ tu salilam ca abhi matraṃyet

original: ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālaustmatvā ayukasya kṣiprā rogārdhamamukājñayā triṃbaka pūjana japādikaṃ kariṣye ||

iti uktvā

original: yamiti dvādaśāvṛtyā - dehaṃ saṃśoṣyaramityagni bījena dagghvāvamitya mṛtabījena āplāvyātmana ākāśaḥ ākāśādvāyuḥ vāyoragni ragnerāpaḥ adbhyaḥ pṛthivīti tasya dehotpattiṃ vibhāvyavamitya mṛtaṃ śrāvayitvā prāmapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā śivoha mitivibhāvyeṣṭa devaṃnatvā vāme guhu paramaguru parāparaguru parameṣṭigurān svabījanāmabhirnatvā mūlena prāṇānāyam ||
analyzed: yam iti dvādaśa āvṛtyā deham saṃśoṣya ram iti agni bījena dagghvā avamitya mṛta bījena āplāvya ātmanaḥ ākāśaḥ ākāśāt vāyuḥ vāyoḥ agniḥ agneḥ āpaḥ adbhyaḥ pṛthivī iti tasya deha utpattim vibhāvya avamitya mṛtam śrāvayitvā prāma pratiṣṭhām kṛtvā śivaḥ ha miti vibhāvya iṣṭa devam natvā vāme guhu parama guru parāpara guru parameṣṭi gurān sva bīja nāmabhiḥ natvā mūlena prāṇān āyam anuprāṇa manas anuprāṇa manas anuprā

original: inya śrīmṛtyuṃjaya mahāmaṃtrasya vasiṣṭhaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭhup chaṃdaḥ || mṛtyuṃjaya maṃtrajape viniyogaḥ || śuddha tryaṃbaketryaṃ bījaṃ | aṃ śakti | vaṃ kīlakamiti maṃtrakośe akṣi śiromukha hṛdaya guhyapādeṣu ṛṣyādī nvinyasyamūlena karaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ karatala yoḥ syaset | oṃ agnaye hṛdayāya namaḥ | triṃbakāya śirase svāhā | trinetrāya śikhāyai ||
analyzed: śrī mṛtyuṃjaya mahā maṃtrasya vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭhubh chaṃdaḥ mṛtyuṃjaya maṃtra jape viniyogaḥ bījam aṃ śakti vaṃ kīlakam iti maṃtrakośe akṣi śiras mukha hṛdaya guhya pādeṣu ṛṣi ādīn vinyasya mūlena kara śuddhim kṛtvā praṇavam kara talayoḥ syaset om agnaye hṛdayāya namaḥ triṃbakāya śirase svāhā trinetrāya śikhāyai

original: vasiṣṭhāya kavacāya huṃ | anuṣṭup chaṃdase netratrayāya vauṣaṭ rudro devatā astrāyaphaṭ ||

original: tryaṃbakaṃ hṛdayāya | yajāmahe śirase | sugaṃdhaṃ puṣṭivarthanaṃ śikhāyai | urvāruka mivabaṃdhanā tkavacāyahuṃ || mṛtyo rmukṣīya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | māmṛtādastrāya phaṭ ||
analyzed: tryaṃbakam hṛdayāya yajāmahe śirase sugaṃdham puṣṭi varthanam śikhāyai urvārukam miva baṃdhanāt kavacāya hum mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ mā amṛtāt astrāya phaṭ
atha pāda nyāsaḥ

original: oṃ tryiyaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe pūrvavaktraya namaḥ | oṃ sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ paścima vaktrāya namaḥ | oṃ uruvāruka miva baṃdhanāt dakṣiṇa vaktrāya nāmaḥ | oṃ mṛtyo rmukṣīya māmṛtādityuttara vaktrāya namaḥ | omiti sarvarchā ūrdhvā vaktrāya namaḥ ||
analyzed: om tryiyaṃbakam yajāmahe pūrva vaktraya namaḥ om sugaṃdhim puṣṭi vardhanam paścima vaktrāya namaḥ om uruvārukam iva baṃdhanāt dakṣiṇa vaktrāya nāmaḥ om mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya mā amṛtāt iti uttara vaktrāya namaḥ om iti sarva ṛchā ūrdhvā vaktrāya namaḥ
adha akṣara nyāsaḥ

original: sarvatra praṇavādi namoṃ tatvaṃ | tryaṃ dakṣiṇapādamūle | baṃda dakṣiṇajānuni | kaṃ dakṣiṇagulphe | yaṃ dakṣiṇa pādāṃguli muleṣu | jāṃ tadagreṣu | maṃ vāmapāmūle | hṃ
analyzed: sarvatra praṇava ādi namaḥ om dakṣiṇa jānuni kaṃ dakṣiṇa gulphe yaṃ dakṣiṇa pāda aṃguli muleṣu jāṃ tad agreṣu maṃ vāma apāmūle hṃ

original: vāmajānuni | suṃ vāmagulbhe | gaṃ vāmapādāṃgūli mūleṣu | diṃ tavagreṣu puṃguhye | ṣṭiṃ ādhāre | vaṃ udare | rdhaṃ hṛdaye naṃ kaṃṭhe || urvāruka mitye tāni dakṣiṇa bāhu saṃdhiṣu | vabaṃdhanānmṛṃ vāma bāhu saṃdhiṣu || tyoṃ mukhe rmuṃ kṣiṃ dakṣiṇa vāmanāsayoḥ || yaṃ netrayoḥ | māṃ karṇayoḥ || mṛṃ bhṛvormadhye | tāt śirasi || adha vadanyānaḥ |
analyzed: vāma jānuni suṃ vāma gulbhe gaṃ vāma pāda aṃgūli mūleṣu diṃ tavagreṣu puṃ guhye ṣṭiṃ ādhāre vaṃ udare ṭiṃ hṛdaye naṃ kaṃṭhe urvāruka tāni dakṣiṇa bāhu saṃdhiṣu vāma bāhu saṃdhiṣu tyoṃ mukhe rmuṃ kṣiṃ dakṣiṇa vāma nāsayoḥ yaṃ netrayoḥ māṃ karṇayoḥ mṛṃ bhṛvoḥ madhye śirasi adha vadanyānaḥ

original: tryaṃbakaṃ śirase || yajāmahe bhṛvormadhyāya sugaṃdhiṃ netrābhyāḥ | puṣṭivardanaṃ mukhāya | urvārukaṃ gaṃḍābhyāṃ | iva hṛdayāya | baṃdhanāt udarāya | mṛtyorgulphāya | mukṣiya mūrubhyāṃ | amṛtātpādābhyāṃ || adhākṣarādinyāsaṃ oṃ triṃ adharvāya śirase namaḥ | yaṃ dhṛvaya netrābhyāṃ baṃsaumāya karṇābhyāṃ | kaṃ adphyonāpā puṭāya | yaṃ anilāya mukhe |
analyzed: tryaṃbakam śirase yajāmahe bhṛvoḥ madhyāya sugaṃdhim netrābhyāḥ puṣṭi vardanam mukhāya urvārukam gaṃḍābhyām iva hṛdayāya baṃdhanāt udarāya mṛtyoḥ gulphāya mūrubhyām amṛtāt pādābhyām adha akṣara ādi nyāsam om triṃ adharvāya śirase namaḥ yam netrābhyām karṇābhyām kaṃ puṭāya yaṃ anilāya mukhe

original: jāṃ ānalāya dakṣiṇa bāhumūlāya | kuṃ pratyūṣāya kūrparāya | heṃ prabhāsāya dakṣiṇa maṇi baṃdhāya | suṃ vīrabhadrāya dakṣiṃguli mūlebhyo | gaṃ śaṃbhave tatagrāya | dhiṃ giriśāya vāma bāhu mūlāya | puṃ acaika pādāya vāma kūrparāya | ṣṭiṃ ahirbudhnyāya vāmamaṇi baṃdhāya | vaṃ pinākine vāsūṃguli mūlebhyo namaḥ | rdhaṃ aparājitāya tadagrāya |
analyzed: jāṃ ānalāya dakṣiṇa bāhumūlāya kuṃ pratyūṣāya kūrparāya heṃ prabhāsāya dakṣiṇa maṇi baṃdhāya suṃ vīrabhadrāya dakṣiṃguli mūlebhyaḥ gaṃ śaṃbhave tatagrāya dhiṃ giriśāya vāma bāhu mūlāya puṃ acaika pādāya vāma kūrparāya ṣṭiṃ ahirbudhnyāya vāma maṇi baṃdhāya vaṃ pinākine namaḥ ṛdhaṃ aparājitāya tadagrāya

original: naṃ bhuvanādhīśvarāya dakṣiṇa pādamūlāya | uṃ kapāline dakṣijānave namaḥ | rvāṃ sthāṇeve dakṣagulbhāya | ruṃ bhargāya dakṣa pādāṃguli mūlebhyo | kaṃ thātre tadagrebhyo namaḥ | miṃ aryamṇevāmoru mūlāya | vaṃ miāya vāma jānave namaḥ | baṃ varuṇāya vāmagulphāya | dhaṃ dharmāya vāmapādāya | nāt bhagāya tadireṣu | mṛṃ iṃdrāya dakṣa pārśvāya |
analyzed: naṃ bhuvana adhīśvarāya dakṣiṇa pāda mūlāya um kapāline dakṣi jānave namaḥ rvāṃ dakṣa gulbhāya ruṃ bhargāya dakṣa pāda aṃguli mūlebhyaḥ kaṃ thātre tad agrebhyaḥ namaḥ miṃ aryamṇe vāma ūru mūlāya vaṃ miāya vāma jānave namaḥ baṃ varuṇāya vāma gulphāya dhaṃ dharmāya vāma pādāya nāt bhagāya tadireṣu mṛṃ iṃdrāya dakṣa pārśvāya

original: rtyoṃ yamāya vāma pārśvāṃ | muṃ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣvā | kṣīṃ parjanyāya bhṛvormadyāya | yaṃ tvaṣṭre lalāṭāya | māṃ viṣṇave śirase namaḥ mṛṃ prajāpataye kaṃṭhāya | tādvaṣaṭkārāya hṛdayāya praṇavaṃ japet ||
analyzed: yamāya vāma pārśvāṇ muṃ pṛṣṭhe pṛṣvā kṣīṃ parjanyāya bhṛvoḥ madyāya yam tvaṣṭre lalāṭāya mām viṣṇave śirase namaḥ mṛṃ prajāpataye kaṃṭhāya tādvaṣaṭkārāya hṛdayāya praṇavam japet
athā paras

original: triṃbakaṃ yaṃ - etānmukhasya pūrva paścima dakṣiṇottareṣu nyaset | jāṃ urasimaṃgale | heṃ mukhe | sugaṃnetrayoḥ | dhiṃnābhau | puṃ hṛdaye | ṣṭiṃ pṛṣṭhe | rthaṃ kṛkṣyoḥ | naṃ liṃge | uṃ pāyau | rvāṃ ūrvoḥ | rudhakaṃ jānyoḥ | miṃ vaṃjaṃghayoḥ | baṃdhaṃstanayoḥ | nāṃsmṛṃ pārśvayoḥ | tyoṃrmuṃ pādayoḥ | kṣīṃ yaṃ pāṇyoḥ | māṃ mṛṃ nāsikayoḥ |
analyzed: triṃbakam yaṃ etān mukhasya pūrva paścima dakṣiṇa uttareṣu nyaset jāṃ urasi maṃgale heṃ mukhe sugaṃ netrayoḥ dhiṃ nābhau puṃ hṛdaye ṣṭiṃ pṛṣṭhe rthaṃ kṛ kṣyoḥ naṃ liṃge uṃ pāyau rvāṃ ūrvoḥ rudha kaṃ jānyoḥ miṃ vaṃ jaṃghayoḥ baṃ dhan stanayoḥ nāṃ smṛṃ pārśvayoḥ tyoṃ rmuṃ pādayoḥ kṣīṃ yaṃ pāṇyoḥ māṃ mṛṃ nāsikayoḥ

original: tāt śirasi | adhahemādrau śaunakoktanyāsaḥ | traṃbakaṃ yajāmahe śikhāyāṃ | sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ hṛdaye | urvāruka mivabaṃdhāna dbāhoḥ | mṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt nābhau | tyaṃ pādayoḥ baṃgulbhayoḥ | kaṃjaṃghayoḥ | yaṃ ūrvoḥ | jāṃ jaghane | maṃ kaṭau | hṃ meḍhre | suṃ nābhau | gaṃ kukṣauḥ dhiṃ pārśvayoḥ | puṃ vakṣasi | ṣṭiṃ stanayoḥ ||
analyzed: śirasi adha hemādrau śaunaka ukta nyāsaḥ traṃbakam yajāmahe śikhāyām sugaṃdhim puṣṭi vardhanam hṛdaye urvārukam mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya mā amṛtāt nābhau tyaṃ pādayoḥ baṃgulbhayoḥ kaṃ jaṃghayoḥ yaṃ ūrvoḥ jāṃ jaghane maṃ kaṭau hṃ meḍhre suṃ nābhau gaṃ kukṣau dhiṃ pārśvayoḥ puṃ vakṣasi ṣṭiṃ stanayoḥ

original: vaṃ hṛdirdhaṃ skaṃdhayoḥ | naṃ kaṃṭhe | uṃ kūrparayoḥ | rvāṃ maṇibaṃdhayoḥ | ruṃ kaniṣṭhayoḥ | kaṃ anāmikayoḥ | miṃ madhyamayoḥ | vaṃ tarjanyoḥ | baṃ aṃguṣṭhayoḥ | dhaṃ pāṇyoḥ | nāṃ kapolayoḥ | mṛṃ cubuke | tyoṃ mukhe | rmuṃ nāsayoḥ | kṣiṃ karṇayoḥ | yaṃ netrayoḥ | māṃ lalāṭe | mṛṃ mūrdhani | tāt śikhāyāṃ | ete kevalaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayanyāpāḥ |
analyzed: vaṃ hṛdis dhaṃ skaṃdhayoḥ naṃ kaṃṭhe uṃ kūrparayoḥ rvāṃ maṇibaṃdhayoḥ ruṃ kaniṣṭhayoḥ kaṃ anāmikayoḥ miṃ madhyamayoḥ vaṃ tarjanyoḥ baṃ aṃguṣṭhayoḥ dhaṃ pāṇyoḥ nāṃ kapolayoḥ mṛṃ cubuke tyoṃ mukhe rmuṃ nāsayoḥ kṣiṃ karṇayoḥ yaṃ netrayoḥ māṃ lalāṭe mṛṃ mūrdhani śikhāyām ete kevalam mṛtyum jayan yāpāḥ

original: mahā mṛtyuṃjayepyeta deva kiṃtu pratyakṣaraṃ vyāhṛti trayaṃ praṇava pūrvaṃvadet ||
analyzed: deva kiṃtu pratyakṣaram vyāhṛti trayam praṇava pūrvam vadet

original: oṃ bhūḥ - oṃ bhūvaḥ - oṃ suvaḥ - oṃ tryaṃ dakṣiṇa pāda mūle - hauṃ - oṃ - juṃ - oṃ saḥ itivā prativarṇaṃ pratipada mādau vadet | athanāma ṣaḍaṃgaḥ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavaṭhe rudrāya śūlapāṇaye svāha hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya amṛta mūrtaye māṃjīva ya śirase |
analyzed: om bhūḥ om bhūvaḥ om suvar om dakṣiṇa pāda mūle hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ iti vā prativarṇam om saḥ iti vā prativarṇam om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya śūlapāṇaye svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya amṛta mūrtaye māṃjīva ya śirase

original: oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya caṃdra śirase jaṭise śikhāyai | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya tripurāṃtakāya hrīṃ hrīṃ kavacāya | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya bhilocanāya ṛgyajussāma maṃtrāya svāhā netratrayāya vauṣace |
analyzed: om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya candra śirase śikhāyai om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya tripurāṃtakāya hrīṃ hrīṃ kavacāya om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya ṛc yajus sāma maṃtrāya svāhā netratrayāya vauṣace

original: oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya pralayāgni rudrāya netratrayāya jvala jvala māṃ rakṣa rakṣa aghoramūrtaye astrāya phaṭ | atha tṛtīya ṣaḍaṃgaḥ - oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya triyaṃbakāya trinetrāya tripurāṃtakāya tryiṃbakaṃ hṛdayāya |
analyzed: om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya pralayāgni rudrāya netratrayāya jvala jvala mām rakṣa rakṣa aghora mūrtaye astrāya phaṭ atha tṛtīya ṣaḍaṃgaḥ om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya tryaṃbakāya trinetrāya tripurāṃtakāya tryiṃbakam hṛdayāya

original: oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya nīlagrīvāya śaśāṃka dhṛtaśekharāyāmṛta varṣiṇe yajā mahe śirase | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya vyāghra carma paridhānāya kapardine sugaṃdhiṃ pu,ṭi vardhanaṃ śikhāyai |
analyzed: om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya nīlagrīvāya śaśāṃka dhṛta śekharāya amṛta varṣiṇe yaja mahe śirase om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya vyāghra carma paridhānāya kapardine sugaṃdhim puṭi vardhanam śikhāyai

original: oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya pinākadhāriṇe nāgābharaṇāya daṃḍamālā dharāya urvāruka mivabaṃdhanā tkavacāya huṃ | oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya ṛgya jussāma maṃtrāya jyoti rūpāya jñānātmane mṛtyormukṣīya netratrayāya |
analyzed: om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya pināka dhāriṇe nāga ābharaṇāya daṃḍa mālā dharāya hum om hauṃ om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavante rudrāya maṃtrāya jyotiḥ rūpāya jñāna ātmane netratrayāya

original: oṃ hauṃ oṃ juṃ oṃ saḥ oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya agnijījāya duṣṭagraha nivāraṇāya dūrjaṭine aghoramūrtaye jvala jvala rudra śakti triśūladhara māṃ rakṣa rakṣa sarvatos bhayaṃ diśa aghorāya māmṛtā castrāya phaṭ | tataḥ pīṭhā daumadhye vṛttaṃ | dbahiścatu rasraṃtadbahiḥ ṣaḍrasaṃ - tadbahi raṣṭadala dvayaṃ tataścatuṣkoṇa miti yaṃtraṃ vilikhya |
analyzed: om   om juṃ om saḥ om namaḥ bhagavate rudrāya duṣṭa graha nivāraṇāya dūrjaṭine aghora mūrtaye jvala jvala rudra śakti triśūla dhara mām rakṣa rakṣa sarvatos bhayam diśa aghorāya mā amṛta castrāya phaṭ tatas vṛttam tad bahis ṣaṣ rasam tad bahis raṣṭadala dvayam tatas catuṣkoṇa miti yantram vilikhya
