original: prajāpati ścaturbāhuḥ kamaṃḍalvakṣa sūtra dhṛt | varābhaya karaśśuklo rohiṇedevatāstume | rohiṇī nakṣatradevatāṃ prajāpati māvāhayāmi | prajāpate rohiṇī vetviti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ ścatur bāhuḥ kamaṃḍalu akṣa sūtra dhṛt vara abhaya karaḥ śuklaḥ rohiṇī devatāḥ tu me rohiṇī nakṣatra devatām prajāpatim āvāhayāmi prajāpate rohiṇī vetu iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: śveta varṇākṛti ssomodvibhūjo varadaṃta bhṛt | daśāśvaradhamārūḍho mṛgaśīrṣostumemude || somorājeti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: śveta varṇa ākṛti somaḥ rājā iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: rudraśśveta vṛṣārūḍha śśvetamālya ścaturbhujaḥ | śūlakaḍhgā bhayavarān dadhānome prasīdatu || ārdrā nakṣatra devatāṃ rudra māvāhayāmi || ārdrayo rudra iti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: rudraḥ śveta vṛṣa ārūḍhaḥ śveta mālyaḥ catur bhujaḥ śūla kaḍhgāḥ bhaya varān dadhānaḥ me prasīdatu ārdrā nakṣatra devatām rudra mā āvāhayāmi ārdrayoḥ rudraḥ iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: aditiḥ pīḍavarṇāca sruksravaṃ darbha saṃyutaṃ | dadhānā śubhadābhūyā tpunarvasu kṛtāhvayā || punarno devīti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: aditiḥ sruc sravam darbha saṃyutam dadhānā śubha dā bhūyāt punarvasu kṛta āhvayā punar naḥ devī iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: vaṃde bṛhaspatiṃ puṣya devatāṃ mānuṣā kṛtiṃ | sarvābharaṇasaṃpannaṃ devamantiṇa mādarāt || puṣya nakṣatra devatāṃ bṛhaspati māvāhayāmi || bṛhaspatiḥ pradhamamiti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: vaṃde bṛhaspatim puṣya devatām mānuṣā kṛtim sarva ābharaṇa saṃpannam deva mantiṇam ādarāt puṣya nakṣatra devatām bṛhaspatim āvāhayāmi bṛhaspatiḥ pūjā japaḥ ca

original: sarporakta triṇetraśca phalarāsi karadvayaḥ | āśreṣā devatāpītāṃbara dhṛdvaradontume || idagaṃ sarvebhya iti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: trinetraḥ ca phala rāsi kara dvayaḥ āśreṣā devatā pīta aṃbara sarvebhyaḥ iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: pitaraḥ piṃḍahastāśca kṛśādhūmrāḥ pavitriṇaḥ | kuśalaṃ dadyulasmākaṃ maghā nakṣatra devatāḥ || upahutāḥ pitara iti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: pitaraḥ piṃḍa hastāḥ ca kṛśa a dhūmrāḥ pavitriṇaḥ kuśalam dadyuḥ asmākam maghā nakṣatra devatāḥ upahutāḥ pitaraḥ iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: saṃpūja yāmyarya maṇaṃ phalguvītāra devatān || dhūmravarma rathārūḍhaṃ saśaktikara saṃyutam || pūrvāphalgunī devatāṃ sūryamāvāhayāmu || gavāṃ vatiriti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: saṃpūjay devatān dhūmra varma ratha ārūḍham sa śakti kara saṃyutam pūrvāphalgunī devatām sūryam āvāhayāmu gavām vatiḥ iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: bhagaṃvara radhārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ śaṃkha cakriṇaṃ | phalgunī devatāṃdhyāye dbhaktābhīṣṭa varapradaṃ || uttarāphalgunī nakṣatradevatāṃ bhagamāvāhayāmi || śreṣṭho devānāmiti pūjā japaśca || ||
analyzed: bhagaṃvara dvi bhujam śaṃkha cakriṇam phalgunī devatām dhyāye vara pradam uttarā phalgunī nakṣatra devatām bhagam āvāhayāmi śreṣṭhaḥ devānām iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: savitāra mahaṃvaṃde saptāśaavaratha vāhanam | padmānanasthaṃ chāyeśaṃ hastānakṣatra devatām || āyutu devassavitopayātviti pūjājapaśca || ||
analyzed: savitāra mahaṃvaṃde vāhanam padma ānana stham chāyā īśam hastā nakṣatra devatām āyutu devaḥ savitā upayātu iti pūjā japaḥ ca

original: tvaṣṭāraṃ radhamārūḍhaṃ cittānakṣatra devatāṃ | śaṃkha cakrānvitakaraṃ kirīṭina mahaṃbhaje || tvaṣṭā nakṣatra mabhyetīti pūjā || ||
analyzed: tvaṣṭāram radham ārūḍham cittā nakṣatra devatām śaṃkha cakra anvita karam kirīṭinam aham bhaje tvaṣṭā nakṣatram abhyeti iti pūjā

original: vāyuṃ mṛgavarārūḍhaṃ svātī nakṣatra devatāṃ | kheṭa carmojjvala karidvitayaṃ praṇamāmyahaṃ || vāyurnakṣatra miti pūjā || ||
analyzed: vāyum mṛga vara ārūḍham svāti nakṣatra devatām kheṭa carma ujjvala kari dvitayam praṇamāmi aham vāyuḥ nakṣatra miti pūjā

original: iṃdrīgnī śubhadau syātāṃviśākhā devate ubhau | namomyeka rathā rūḍhau varābhīti karāṃbūjau || viśākhā nakṣatra devate iṃdrāgī māvāhayāmi || dura masma ccatrava iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: iṃdrī ignī śubha dau syātām viśākhā devate ubhau namaḥ ūmi eka rathā rūḍhau vara abhi iti kara ambūjau viśākhā nakṣatra devate iṃdrāgī mā āvāhayāmi iti pūjā

original: mitraṃ padmāsanārūḍha manūrādheśvaraṃ bhaje | śūlāṃguśa dharaṃ bāhvoḥ devaṃ śoṇitavarṇakam || ṛdhyāsmahavyairiti pūjā || ||
analyzed: mitram padmāsana ārūḍha manuḥ rādhā īśvaram bhaje śūla aṃguśa dharam bāhvoḥ devam śoṇita varṇakam ṛdhyāsma havyaiḥ iti pūjā

original: iṃdraṃ gajavarā rūḍhaṃ vajrapāśa varābhayam | karaiścaturbhirdhadhataṃ jyeṣṭhaṃdhīśvara māśraye || iṃdro jyeṣṭhāmiti pūjā || ||
analyzed: iṃdram gaja varāḥ rūḍham vajrapāśa vara abhayam karaiḥ caturbhiḥ dhadhatam mā āśraye iṃdraḥ jyeṣṭhām iti pūjā

original: karāla vadanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yātu dhānaṃ nṛvāhanaṃ | ūrdhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhaje mūlādhi devatām || mūlaṃ prajāmiti pūjā || ||
analyzed: karāla vadanam kṛṣṇam yātu dhānam nṛvāhanam ūrdhvakeśam virūpākṣam bhaje mūla adhi devatām mūlam prajām iti pūjā

original: āṣāḍhā devatā nityamāva ssaṃtu śubha pradāḥ | samudra gāstaraṃgiṇyaḥ pāvinya ssarvadehinām || pūrvāṣāḍā nakṣatra devatā apa āvāhayāmi || yā divyā iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: āṣāḍhā devatāḥ nityam āva ssaṃtu śubha pradāḥ samudra gāḥ taraṃgiṇyaḥ pāvinyaḥ ssarva dehinām pūrvāṣāḍā nakṣatra devatāḥ apa āvāhayāmi yā divyā iti pūjā

original: viśvān devānahaṃ vaṃde'ṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatāḥ | śrīpuṣṭi kīrtidhīdhātri ssarvapāpāpa nuttaye || uttarāṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatā viśvān devānāhayāmi || tanno viśva iti pūjā ||
analyzed: viśvān devān aham vaṃda iṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatāḥ śrī puṣṭi kīrti dhī dhātri ssarva pāpa apa nuttaye uttarāṣāḍhā nakṣatra devatāḥ viśvān devān āhayāmi tat naḥ viśve iti pūjā

original: nirguṇaṃ brahma bhūyānmejñā naiśvarya pradaṃ sadā | abhijittarā keśānaṃ vedāṃta kṛta saṃśrayam || abhijinnakṣatra devatāṃ brahmamāvāhayāmi || yasmin brahmeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: nirguṇam brahma sadā keśānam vedāṃta kṛta saṃśrayam abhijit nakṣatra devatām brahmam āvāhayāmi yasmin brahma iti pūjā

original: śāntākāraṃ caturhasantaṃ śroṇā nakṣatra vallabham || viṣṇuṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ dhyāye dgaruḍa vāhanam || śravaṇā nakṣatra devatāṃ viṣṇu māvāhayāmi || śṛṇvāṃ tīti pūjā || ||
analyzed: śānta ākāram catur hasantam śroṇā nakṣatra vallabham viṣṇum kamala patra akṣam dhyāye dgaruḍa vāhanam śravaṇā nakṣatra devatām viṣṇu mā āvāhayāmi śṛṇvām pūjā

original: śraniṣṭhā devatāṃ vaṃde vasūn ratha varāśritān | śaṃkha cakrāṃkita karān kirīṭāṃkita mastakān || dhaniṣṭā nakṣatra devatāvasūmāvāhayāmi || aṣṭau devā vasava iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: śraniṣṭhā devatām vaṃde vasūn ratha vara āśritān śaṃkha cakra aṃkita karān kirīṭa aṃkita mastakān dhaniṣṭhā nakṣatra devatā vasūm āvāhayāmi aṣṭau devāḥ vasavaḥ iti pūjā

original: varuṇaṃ natataṃ vaṃde sūdhā kalaśa dhāriṇaṃ | pāśahastaṃ śatabhiṣagdevatāṃ deva vaṃditam || śatabiṣaṅna nakṣatra devatā varuṇamāvāhayāmi || kṣatrasya rājeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: varuṇam vaṃde sūdhā kalaśa dhāriṇam pāśa hastam śatabhiṣaj devatām deva vaṃditam nakṣatra devatā varuṇam āvāhayāmi kṣatrasya rājā iti pūjā

original: śirasāha nujaṃ vaṃde ekapādaṃ tamopahaṃ | mude proṣthapade śānaṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtam || pūrvābhādapada nakṣatra devatā majamekapādamāvāhayāmi || āja ekapādudagāditi pūjā || ||
analyzed: śirasā āha vaṃde eka pādam tama upaham mude proṣthapade śānam sarva deva namaskṛtam nakṣatra devatā majam eka pādam āvāhayāmi ājaḥ ekapād udagāt iti pūjā

original: ahirme budhniyo bhūyānmude proṣṭhapadeśvaraḥ | śaṃkha cakhrāṃ kita karaḥ rarīṭo jvalamaulimān || uttarābhādra devatā mahirbudhniyamāvāhayāmi || ahirpudhnaya iti pājā || ||
analyzed: ahiḥ me budhniyaḥ bhūyāt mude proṣṭhapada īśvaraḥ śaṃkha cakhrām kita karaḥ rarīṭaḥ jvala maulimān uttarābhādra devatā mahirbudhniyam āvāhayāmi ahiḥ pudhnaye iti pājā

original: pūṣaṇaṃ dvipadaṃ vaṃde revatīśaṃ samuddaye | varā bhayojjvala karaṃ ratna siṃhāsane sthitaṃ | revatī nakṣatra devatāṃ pūṣaṇamāvāhayāmi || pūṣā revatyanveti pūjā || ||
analyzed: pūṣaṇam dvipadam vaṃde revatī īśam samuddaye varā bhaya ujjvala karam ratna siṃhāsane sthitam revatī nakṣatra devatām pūṣaṇam āvāhayāmi pūṣā revatī anveti pūjā

original: aśvinau devate śvetavarṇau taudvi bhūjāstumaḥ | sūdhā saṃpūrṇa kalaśa karābbāvaśva vāhanau || aśvinī nakṣatra aśvināvāhayāmi || dataśvināviti pājā japaśca || ||
analyzed: aśvinau devate śveta varṇau sūdhā saṃpūrṇa kalaśa karābbau aśva vāhanau aśvinī nakṣatra aśvinau āhayāmi dataśvinau iti pājā japaḥ ca

original: pāśa daṃḍojjvala bhūjadvayaṃ mahiṣa vāhanam | yamaṃ nīlatanuṃ bhīmaṃ baraṇī devatāṃ bhajhe || bharaṇī nakṣatra devatāṃ yama māvāhayāmi || tadyayorājeti pūjā japaḥ || ||
analyzed: pāśa daṃḍa ujjvala bhūja dvayam mahiṣa vāhanam yamam nīla tanum bhīmam baraṇī devatām bhajhe bharaṇī nakṣatra devatām yama māvāhayāmi tat yayorājā iti pūjā japaḥ

original: a tha yo ga de va tā dyā nā di
analyzed: a tha yaḥ ga de va tā dyā nā di

original: viṣkaṃbhaṃ śirasā vaṃde viṣṇugotra samudbavam || prāṅmukhaṃ prāṃjali karaṃ trikoṇopari saṃsthitam || oṃ namo viṣkaṃbhāyetyāvāhanādi pūjā || ||
analyzed: viṣkaṃbham śirasā vaṃde viṣṇu gotra prāc mukham prāṃjali karam trikoṇa upari saṃsthitam om namaḥ viṣkaṃbhāya iti āvāhana ādi pūjā

original: prīti mīḍeha maniśaṃ brahmagotra samudbhavaṃ | prāṅ mukhaṃ puṃḍarīkasthaṃ japamālā dharaṃ śubhaṃ || oṃ namaḥ prītaya ityā vāhanādi pūjā || ||
analyzed: brahma gotra samudbhavam prāc mukham puṃḍarīka stham japa mālā dharam śubham om namaḥ prītaye vāhana ādi pūjā

original: āyuṣaṃta mahaṃ vaṃde yogaṃ yogibhirīḍitam | praṅ mukhaṃ paṃcakoṇstha matri gotra samudbhavaṃ || oṃ namaḥ āyuṣmata iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: vaṃde yogam yogibhiḥ īḍitam prak mukham om namaḥ āyuṣmataḥ iti pūjā

original: saubhāgyaṃ naumi śirāsa catuṣkoṇa mupāśritaṃ | kauṃdinya grotra janitaṃ prāṅ mukhaṃ japatāṃ param || oṃ namaḥ ssābhāgyāyodi pūjā || ||
analyzed: saubhāgyam naumi pūjā

original: prāṅ mukhaṃ paṃcakoṇasthaṃ śāṃḍilyānvaya saṃbhavam | śobhanaṃ śobhanakaraṃ samātā māśraye sadā || oṃ namaḥ śśobhanāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: prāc mukham paṃcakoṇa stham śāṃḍilya anvaya saṃbhavam śobhanam śobhana karam samātā mām āśraye sadā om namaḥ śśobhanāya iti pūjā

original: vādhulānvaya saṃbhūtaṃ paṃcakoṇo paristhitaṃ | ati gaṃḍābhidhaṃ vaṃde japaṃtaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sadā || oṃ nameti gaṃḍāyoti pūjā || ||
analyzed: saṃbhūtam gaṃḍa abhidham vaṃde japaṃtam prāc mukham sadā om nama iti gaṃḍāya iti pūjā

original: sukarmāṇaṃ yoga mahaṃ dakṣaṇāmukha māśraye | kauśikānvaya saṃbhūtaṃ japaṃtaṃ loka pūjitaṃ || || oṃ namaḥ ssukarmaṇa iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: sukarmāṇam yoga maham dakṣaṇāmukha māśraye kauśika anvaya saṃbhūtam japaṃtam loka pūjitam om namaḥ iti pūjā

original: dhṛtiryoga ssadābhūyā dātre yānvaya saṃbhavaḥ | dakṣiṇāmukha māsino vedā mreḍana tatparaḥ || || oṃ namo dhṛtaya iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: dhṛtiḥ yogaḥ ssadābhūyāḥ dātre yā anvaya saṃbhavaḥ dakṣiṇāmukha māsinaḥ om namaḥ dhṛtaye iti pūjā

original: śūlanāmā mahānyogo bhūyā diṣṭordhado mama | dakṣiṇāmukha māsīnaḥ kuṃḍinānvaya saṃbhavaḥ || oṃ namaśśulāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: śūla nāmā mahān yogaḥ bhūyāḥ mama dakṣiṇā mukha māsīnaḥ kuṃḍina anvaya saṃbhavaḥ om namaḥ śulāya iti pūjā

original: yogostu gaṃḍanāmāmemu deśāṃḍilya vaṃśajaḥ | dakṣiṇāmukha māsino brahmapārāyaṇaṃ paṭhan || oṃ namaḥ gaṃḍāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: deśāṃḍilya vaṃśa jaḥ dakṣiṇāmukha māsinaḥ brahmapārāyaṇam paṭhan om namaḥ gaṃḍāya iti pūjā

original: vṛddi rvṛddi pradomesu kauśiko dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | ciṃtaya nbrahmā paramaṃ brasī māśrītyaviṣṭitaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ namo vṛddaya iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: kauśikaḥ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ciṃtayan brahmā paramam om namaḥ namaḥ vṛddaye iti pūjā

original: dhṛtyai dhrūvostume nityaṃ yogoyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | akṣamālāṃkarebibhradgāyatrī mādarājjapan || || oṃ namadhṛvāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: dhṛtyai nityam yogaḥ yam dakṣiṇā mukhaḥ akṣamālām karebibhrat gāyatrī mādarāt japan om pūjā

original: vyāghāta śirasānaumi vyāsānvaya samudbhavam | pratyak mukhopa viṣṭaṃtaṃ prryagraravi sannibham || oṃ namaḥ vyāghātāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: vyāghāta śirasā ānaumi vyāsa anvaya samudbhavam om namaḥ vyāghātāya iti pūjā

original: harṣaṇaṃ harṣaṇaṃ vaṃde pratyaṅ mukha mudarbiṣam | paṭhaṃtaṃ dedamaniśaṃ kāśyapānvaya sambhavam || oṃ namaḥ harṣaṇāyetipūjā || ||
analyzed: harṣaṇam harṣaṇam vaṃde paṭhaṃtam om namaḥ harṣaṇāya iti pūjā

original: vajranāma bhavedhyogo bharadvājānvayodbhavaḥ | pratyaṅ mukhamupāsīnaḥ paṭhan praṇava manvaham || oṃ namaḥ prajāyotipūjā || ||
analyzed: vajra nāma bhavet hi yogaḥ bharadvāja anvaya udbhavaḥ pratyaṅ mukham upāsīnaḥ paṭhan praṇava manu aham om namaḥ

original: pratyaṅmākho brahmavaṃśya siddhi siddhi pradostume || viṣṭaro parisaṃviṣṭo sedāṃta paṭhanonmukhaḥ || oṃ namaḥ ssaddhaya iti pūjā || ||
analyzed: brahma vaṃśya siddhi siddhi viṣṭaraḥ om namaḥ iti pūjā

original: smarāmyahaṃ vyatīpātaṃ vītahavyā nvayodbhanam | pratyaṅmakhaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ vedāṃcciṣyā saharniśam || oṃ namovyatīpātāyeti pūjā || ||
analyzed: smarāmi aham vyatīpātam vītahavyā pratyak makham pāṭhayaṃtam vedān ciṣyā saharniśam om namaḥ vyatīpātāya iti pūjā

original: varīyānmāma yogoyaṃ varadostu sadāmama | pratyaṅmakhaḥ prāṃjalikaḥ sāmaveda kuloditaḥ || oṃ namaḥ varīyana itipūjā || ||
analyzed: varīyān māma yogaḥ yam vara daḥ astu sadā mama pratyak makhaḥ prāṃjalikaḥ sāmaveda kula uditaḥ om namaḥ varīyana iti pūjā

original: udaṅmakho brahmagotro yogaḥ parighanāmakaḥ | kailāsa śikharārūḍha ssāmagāyn bhavanmude || oṃ namaḥ varīyasa iti pūjā ||
analyzed: udak makhaḥ brahma gotraḥ yogaḥ parigha nāmakaḥ kailāsa śikhara ārūḍhaḥ bhavat mude om namaḥ varīyase iti pūjā

original: śiva śivāya me bhūyācchi vārādhana tatparaḥ | niṣṇu vaṃśasamudbhāta ṛgadhyāpana tatparaḥ || oṃ namaḥ varaghāyeti pūjā || ||
